articles.title: 三星展示业界首个400层以上V-NAND：高密度堆叠 功耗降低25%
articles.text:
快科技10月19日消息，第五届GMIF创新峰会（GMIF2026）日前在深圳落幕。三星内存中国的CVP兼CTO凯文·尹在大会上发表题为《内存革命：构建智能体AI的基石》的主题演讲，介绍了覆盖从服务器SSD到端侧zNAND-O的完整产品布局。
他指出，随着AI从生成式走向智能体，多个智能体协同处理复杂任务，产生的token数量急剧增加，KV缓存的容量与复用需求随之上升。一旦KV缓存超出GPU内存的承载范围，独立的共享存储层级就变得不可避免。
围绕KV缓存共享，凯文·尹介绍了两种服务器SSD。主打性能的PCIe Gen6产品PM1763采用V-NAND TLC并强化了散热系统，计划在2026年第四季度出样。
在NAND工艺层面，凯文·尹介绍了三星最新的V10 BV-NAND，这是业界首个实现400层以上的产品。相比V9，V10的位密度提升58%，I/O速度提升33%，功耗降低25%。
他提到，其中的关键在于先进键合技术，即把存储单元与外围电路分开制造，再垂直贴合，从而实现高密度堆叠。
针对端侧AI，三星给出的方案是新一代NAND架构zNAND-O，目前正在开发4层与8层两个版本。按照三星的判断，到2030年AI模型的参数规模将超过1万亿，如果沿用现有统一内存架构、把所有权重都放在DRAM里，端侧成本会迅速攀升。
zNAND-O与MPU封装在一起并通过UCIe接口连接，位密度达到DRAM的10倍，读取带宽与读取能效则是NAND闪存的7倍。在使用Moonshot AI的Kimi K2-1T模型进行的模拟中，采用zNAND-O的NPU优化架构在同等性能下把内存成本降到四分之一，所能容纳的模型规模接近原来的两倍。
GMIF每年都会表彰在产业链上推动关键技术突破与计算生态建设的企业。三星半导体凭借zNAND-O三维架构、400层以上V10 NAND、CXL内存以及在DRAM与NAND领域长期的领先位置，获得AI内存与存储产业卓越领导力奖，这也是它连续第二年在这一大会上获奖。
从共享KV缓存所需的高速与大容量服务器SSD，到400层以上的V10 NAND，再到面向端侧的zNAND-O，三星在多个层级上都拿出了对应方案。

articles.title: 独家｜前Graphcore总裁卢涛加入铭芯启睿，要把LPU做成「高铁」
articles.text:
铭芯启睿（MemSilicon）CEO兼联合创始人 卢涛
雷峰网独家获悉，铭芯启睿（MemSilicon）已完成超4亿元A轮融资，本轮融资由博原资本领投，博世创投、创领资本、米哈游、中关村科学城公司、兆易创新等跟投，老股东复容投资、国开科创、恒裕资本、锦秋基金、顺禧基金、小米战投、中科创星持续加注。
前Graphcore总裁兼大中华区总经理卢涛也已加入铭芯启睿，担任CEO兼联合创始人。
在半导体行业深耕二十余年的卢涛，曾担任Cavium中国区总经理、曦智科技副总裁，经历覆盖Arm服务器CPU、大SRAM架构的AI处理器IPU及硅光等领域。
随着卢涛加入，铭芯启睿将在继续推进阻变存储器（RRAM）产业化与商业化的同时，启动第一代LPU研发，将业务从存储延伸至计算。
黄仁勋此前提到，“速度就是智能”。卢涛的理解有两个维度：记忆力好、脑瓜子快。对应到AI，前者是上下文能力，后者是推理延迟和生成速度。
这与铭芯启睿押注的存储、计算两条路线形成呼应，既研究数据怎样存，也研究怎样更快地计算和调用，最终在系统层面实现协同。
卢涛的目标非常明确，要做一款“满血模型、高铁价格”的LPU。
卢涛与铭芯启睿的交集始于公司成立的2024年。彼时，铭芯就曾邀请他担任CEO，但他没有加入。两年后，是什么改变了他的选择？
LPU热潮下，既知道怎么做，也清楚为什么做
今年3月的GTC成为卢涛做决定的一个触发点。看到黄仁勋发布产品时，他强烈地怀念起过去与芯片巨头竞争的日子，在Graphcore挑战英伟达，在Cavium做服务器CPU与英特尔竞争，做交换芯片与博通竞争。
从零创业是一个选项。但他算了一笔时间账：组建团队、确定架构、融资交割，即使资本市场火热，也需要六至九个月。他不确信热度能持续多久。
“速度非常非常重要。”加入铭芯，能让他更快起步。
2024年没有加入铭芯，也与双方所处的阶段有关。当时铭芯优先推动存储技术从实验室走向产品，卢涛觉得自己能够贡献的价值有限。而在此次加入之前，铭芯已决定进入计算领域，他能在这里自主推进想做的产品。
更重要的是，铭芯团队源自中国科学院刘明院士团队，拥有二十余年存储技术积累。除RRAM外，团队在SRAM、MRAM、DRAM等领域也有研究基础，能与他的计算架构和产业化经验结合。
加入后，卢涛迅速组建了一支十几人的LPU核心团队，覆盖硬件、编译器和系统软件等核心环节。他尤其看重过去在Graphcore与头部客户在实践中摸索出的经验，新架构如何落地，成功与失败分别因为什么。
“把AI芯片做出来很困难，把它卖出更是不简单。”卢涛深有感触。
他用know-how（怎么做）与know-why（为什么做）概括团队的能力：既知道怎样把芯片做出来，也清楚为什么做，以及最终要向用户提供什么价值。在他看来，已有众多GPU、NPU公司的今天，新团队需要从尚未解决的问题出发确定架构。
LPU让高速推理像高铁一样成为主流
铭芯首款LPU的产品目标，是面向数万亿参数的完整模型，不依赖量化、投机解码等手段，追求每名用户每秒生成1000个Token的速度。
速度之外，还有价格。
卢涛用高铁打比方，用户愿意为更好的速度和体验付费，但如果普通车票200元，高铁票却要2000元，就很难普及。高速推理也一样，可以比普通服务贵，但溢价必须有限。
“它未来不是利基，而是一个主流。”卢涛希望让铭芯的LPU跑满血模型，实现高速Token，越级性价比。
要实现这个目标，关键在于存储、计算与互联的联合创新。
卢涛曾参与商业化的Graphcore IPU采用大SRAM架构。在他看来，SRAM能提供高带宽、低延迟，但面对数万亿参数模型，容量成为约束。若通过增加芯片来容纳模型，跨芯片互联又会带来成本、功耗和时间开销。
因此，铭芯的LPU希望保留SRAM的速度优势，同时引入其他介质的容量优势，用更少的芯片承载大模型，控制互联代价。
“在SRAM之外，我们还有新的存储媒介层。”卢涛介绍了第一代LPU的设计思路。这一设计希望从系统层面平衡速度、容量与成本，同时兼顾系统吞吐。
卢涛明确，第一代LPU不会采用RRAM，将使用更成熟的存储介质。RRAM仍需攻坚容量，未来再争取与计算产品结合。
目前，铭芯正与头部云服务商、大模型公司交流。对于未来两三年，卢涛希望将计算产品交到客户手中，同时推动大容量RRAM研发。
铭芯的差异化，在于存储器件、工艺积累与计算架构、软件及产业化经验在同一支团队中结合。卢涛的加入，让这家公司的技术积累有机会从存储延伸至完整的计算系统，也为“满血模型、高铁价格”提供了持续演进的空间。
更多国产芯片公司的信息欢迎添加作者微信BENSONEIT互通有无。雷峰网

articles.title: Anthropic, Musk Offer Competing Visions for Sharing AI Wealth
articles.text: Anthropic plans to dedicate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, offering its own approach to sharing the potential wealth created by AI as concerns grow about AI-driven labor disruption. Bloomberg’s Mike Shepard discusses how the plan differs from proposals for a government-run fund - and from Elon Musk’s pledge to give every child in America a share of SpaceX - as technology leaders confront a broader question: who should benefit financially from the AI boom? He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: 特斯拉飞行汽车被质疑是噱头！网友：若是国内厂商，分分钟被骂到退市；王自如称「想与罗永浩和解」 ；OpenAI透露人形机器人项目进展
articles.text:
要闻提示
1.特斯拉飞行汽车被质疑是噱头！网友：若是国内厂商，分分钟被骂到退市2.加价大几千买iPhone Duo消费者发声：想成为朋友圈第一个用上的人3.王自如称“想与罗永浩和解”4.DeepSeek V4.1 Flash新版本发布！网友怒赞：太上进，超级斩杀线5.比亚迪第三代秦 PLUS 实车曝光，预计 10 月下旬上市6.英伟达优化 Kimi K3 模型推理速度，提升 1.68 倍7.京东：未来 5 年将创造超 10 万个机器人维修工程师就业岗位
8.OpenAI 将研发人形机器人，奥尔特曼称核心是打造“大脑”
今日头条
特斯拉飞行汽车被质疑是噱头！网友：若是国内厂商，分分钟被骂到退市
10月18日消息，日前，特斯拉正式发布新一代纯电超跑Roadster，凭借凌空倒挂、原地起飞、空中翻转等一系列惊人特技引发关注。不过，这款号称能够“飞起来”的超级跑车，也因实际使用场景和法规限制受到质疑，相关话题“特斯拉飞行汽车被质疑是噱头”登上热搜引发热议。
据国内媒体报道，不少业内人士认为，Roadster虽然展示了惊人的工程技术，但这些特殊功能在实际使用中仍面临场景和法规限制，所谓“飞行汽车”可能更多是一种噱头。毕竟，短暂腾空和空中翻转并不意味着车辆具备持续飞行能力，与真正能够用于日常出行的飞行汽车仍有明显区别。此外，特斯拉的这款车辆归谁管目前尚未有明确答案。有网友犀利调侃称：“这款特斯拉第二代Roadster纯电超跑，实际用途不如国产新能源的冰箱彩电大沙发。”还有网友称：“特斯拉Roadster要换作是国内任何一家上市厂商发布，分分钟被骂到退市。”也有博主表示，往汽车壳子装了气体推进装置，在短时间内控制它在空中翻转几下，然后美其名曰“飞行汽车”，“这飞的哪门子行？”（快科技、鞭牛士）国内资讯
加价大几千买iPhone Duo消费者发声：想成为朋友圈第一个用上的人
10月18日消息，起售价15999元的iPhone Duo火爆程度远超所有人预期，10月16日预售开启不到30分钟，全球多地的 iPhone Duo 预计发货日期就已经排到1月25日左右。
值得注意的是，消费者明明可以等几个月原价买到新机，但还是有人愿意加价大几千甚至上万元，专门去抢首批现货的iPhone Duo。一位成都消费者透露，自己连续刷了三天抢购通道，最后加价五千多拿下了256GB黑色版本，核心诉求就是想成为自己朋友圈里第一个用上折叠屏iPhone的人，对他来说首批现货的稀缺感本身就已经值回票价。抱着类似想法的消费者不在少数，相比产品本身的实用属性，加价抢首发能获得的社交圈层情绪价值，才是驱动这批人愿意付出高额溢价的核心原动力。消费电子行业分析师表示，苹果首款折叠屏首秀就出现超高溢价完全在意料之内，本质是首发阶段短期供需错配带来的正常市场现象。（快科技）
王自如称“想与罗永浩和解”
10 月 18 日消息，据报道，在微博 V 影响力大会科技论坛上，王自如就“再给一次机会，是否还会和罗永浩吵架”作出回应。他表示：“我下次可能就是十字路口了吧，借微博喊话，不吵了和解了。如果你想吵架成为大 V 的话，输赢并不重要，比如我是吧。”
2014 年 8 月，王自如与罗永浩的一场直播交锋轰动互联网，核心围绕锤子手机 T1 的评测争议展开，起因是王自如的测评机构 ZEALER 发布锤子 T1 评测视频，指出手机存在屏幕易碎、散热设计缺陷、品控不稳定等问题。罗永浩认为评测存在事实错误和恶意倾向，公开约战王自如直播对质。在直播中，罗永浩逐条反驳王自如的评测结论，王自如全程被动，被罗永浩现场压制。当年报道，王自如后续于 9 月 1 日发布《致歉 & 声明》称，“我们要为 T1 测评视频当中的技术错误和语言表达错误道歉”，“我们要对视频素材拍摄当中存在的不严谨，以及由此可能引发的误导进行道歉”，“我要向一直支持 ZEALER 的朋友们道歉”，“作为团队的负责人，我要向 ZEALER 的每一个成员道歉”。（IT之家）
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash新版本发布！网友怒赞：太上进，超级斩杀线
10月18日消息，日前，据DeepSeek官方公众号，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash现已更新至V4.1-Flash-1017版本，官方网页端、APP与API模型已同步变更为新模型。
据官方介绍，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017通过基于自反馈的强化学习（RL）训练技术，提升了在游戏开发、3D建模等方面从零开始构建完整项目的能力，能够支持实现更多“许愿式”编程任务及项目开发请求。且实测表明，多数场景下Token用量较前版下降逾50%。
不仅如此，本次新版本发布 DeepSeek API 新增对 Search 与 Fetch 接口的支持，相关能力正式向公众开放。据了解，两个接口价格均为5元 / 千次。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash新版本上线后，评论区网友怒赞刷屏，有网友调侃“我就是知道，你那天挂机就是背着我们偷偷进步。太上进了”，还有网友直呼，“ x x什么超级斩杀线”。（快科技、新浪科技）
比亚迪第三代秦 PLUS 实车曝光，预计 10 月下旬上市
10 月 18 日消息，小红书博主 @战神之音分享了比亚迪第三代秦 PLUS 实车外观，该车已经公布官图并完成工信部申报，预计 10 月下旬上市。据悉，比亚迪王朝网销售事业部总经理路天此前对这款新车进行了预热，该车“尺寸更大，空间更大，想象更大”，更多关于它的信息将会陆续发布。
申报信息显示，比亚迪秦 PLUS EV 为纯电动轿车，由比亚迪汽车工业有限公司申报，车身外形尺寸为长 4840 mm、宽 1900 mm、高 1498 mm，轴距达到 2800 mm。动力方面，该车搭载永磁同步驱动电机，型号为 TZ164XYD，由抚州比亚迪实业有限公司生产，峰值功率 100 kW，额定功率 40 kW；储能装置为磷酸铁锂蓄电池，电池单体由贵阳弗迪电池有限公司生产，电池总成由襄阳弗迪电池有限公司生产，防抱死制动系统由弗迪动力有限公司提供，型号为 IPB (FD)。（IT之家）
英伟达优化 Kimi K3 模型推理速度，提升 1.68 倍
10 月 18 日消息，据外媒报道，英伟达通过一项上游 vLLM 优化，让 2.8 万亿参数量的 Kimi K3 模型实现 423 tok/s/user（每用户每秒每 Token）的推理速度，对比相同硬件（GB300 NVL72）性能提升 1.68 倍。
据介绍，该项优化由英伟达 CentML 工程师 Benjamin 完成。它通过大规模 Megakernel 融合，使用 Cute DSL 编写英伟达新推出的解码专用内核。该 Megakernel 包含 1.2 万行代码，代表着 AI 辅助生成高级计算内核的未来方向。英伟达优化 Kimi K3 模型推理速度，提升 1.68 倍。
据了解，英伟达除此之外，还在为 vLLM 开发 DeepSeek V4.1 等其他模型的优化。（IT之家）
字节跳动CFO 高准，上榜2026年「亚洲最具影响力商界女性」
10月18日消息，全球顶级财经媒体《财富》(Fortune)，于近期公布2026年「亚洲最具影响力的商界女性Most Powerful Women Asia」榜单，表彰100位凭借出色的领导力、企业经营表现及个人影响力，推动区域经济未来发展的女性。字节跳动CFO高准（Julie Gao）再次上榜，排在第15位（2025年排名第16位，2024年排名第53位）。
高准，先后获北京大学法学学士、阿拉巴马大学社会学硕士、加州大学洛杉矶分校法学博士。
高准，于2022年4月加入字节跳动、出任首席财务官(CFO)。投资者称赞她是一位坦诚、乐于沟通、能倾听需求的首席财务官。在加入字节跳动之前，高准曾从事律师逾20年，她是世达国际律师事务所高级合伙人，是IPO顶级律师。她的律师生涯中曾帮助一系列中国科技巨头上市，包括京东、拼多多、小米、美团等。（瑞恩资本RyanbenCapital）
DeepSeek将整合多团队成立产品部，崔添翼出任负责人
10月18日消息，据媒体报道，近日，DeepSeek将Harness团队以及Web、App、Platform团队整合成“产品部”，负责公司所有的产品、设计和研发工作，原Harness团队负责人崔添翼任产品部负责人。目前，产品部对外招聘产品设计师和设计师岗位。（科创板日报）
博主曝华为将推子品牌「星芒」手机将主攻线上
10 月 18 日消息，日前，数码博主“数码闲聊站”透露，华为全新子品牌“星芒”手机将主攻线上，定位相对有性价比，目前已经规划了好几款新机，其中还有搭载主动散热风扇的版本。
近期，多方传闻都提到，华为有望推出全新手机子品牌，命名为星芒。有数码博主爆料称，星芒定位对标早年荣耀，主打1799至4000元中端性价比市场，预计今年11月亮相首款机型。
商标记录显示，华为技术有限公司很早便申请“星芒”相关商标，2020年、2023年申请的多枚“星芒”商标已经成功注册；2026年7月，华为再次提交新的“星芒”商标申请，目前状态为“注册申请中”，商标覆盖品类，包含电子设备、通讯相关领域。（鞭牛士）
网传“重庆一车辆从 60 米高架桥坠落”引关注，官方核实系谣言
10 月 18 日消息，近日，有网民在互联网平台发布一则视频并配文称“2026 年 10 月 15 日，重庆武隆高架桥 60 米坠落，驾驶员仅受轻伤奇迹生还”，引发关注。
据“重庆辟谣”微信公众号、网信武隆消息，网传信息系谣言。经向武隆区公安局核实，该区近期未发生相关事件，网传信息不实。据悉，经多方溯源，网传视频中车祸画面系往年外省多个交通事故的现场画面，视频为剪辑拼接，并非同一场事故。目前，警方正对造谣者展开调查。（IT之家）
理想汽车芯片子公司完成首轮16.25亿元融资协议
10月18日消息，理想汽车日前宣布，旗下芯片子公司上海马赫心科技有限公司签署首轮股权融资协议，融资金额为16.25亿元人民币。本轮融资由杭州经韬、蓝驰创投及华业天成领投，奇绩创坛参与投资。
同时，杭州经韬及其关联基金获授最高5亿元人民币的追加认购权，若该认购权悉数行使，投后估值达171亿元。
此次融资将支持马赫心科技持续推进芯片研发与商业化，把握更广泛的产业机遇，尤其是在非汽车领域，推动理想汽车在芯片及域控制器领域的长远发展。（三言科技）
杭州具身大脑创企融资近亿，多家国资投了
10月18日消息，据媒体报道，杭州具身大脑企业格物通智宣布完成近亿元天使轮融资，投资方包括鸿富资产、匹克投资、杭州资本、杭州人才集团、某省级具身产投及多家头部上市公司。
据悉，本轮融资资金将主要用于物理反演世界模型的大规模预训练与技术迭代、硬件与本体构建等，加快人才引进和规模扩充，并推进多个场景PoC验证和真实数据采集。
格物通智成立于2026年，面向真实产业场景研发自进化的灵巧操作智能，致力于通过“世界模型+PSI物理自进化”技术体系，为机器人提供有“手感”的具身大脑。该公司提出了“物理反演世界模型”，让机器人从看得见的动作中推断接触、受力等隐含物理信息，用于大规模预训练。（机器人前瞻）
曝华为 Pura X Max 阔折叠手机销量已破百万台，标准版成功“赶超”典藏版
10 月 18 日消息，长期关注国内手机市场份额的博主 @RD观测 分享了华为折叠屏手机的销量情况：截至 2026 W40（9 月 28 日-10 月 4 日），华为 Pura X Max 约 52.9 万台、Pura X Max 典藏版约 49.31 万台。
从数据来看，华为 Pura X Max 系列横向阔折叠手机的总销量已突破百万台。值得一提的是，普通版终于实现了对典藏版的销量“赶超”，并拉开了约 3.59 万台的差距（此前典藏版的销量长期高于普通版）。此前报道，行业首款横向阔折叠手机 —— 华为 Pura X Max 已于今年 4 月 25 日 10:08 开售，全系搭载麒麟 9030 Pro 旗舰处理器，售价 10999 元起。（IT之家）
京东：未来 5 年将创造超 10 万个机器人维修工程师就业岗位
10月18日消息，据报道，在京东推出机器人维修售后服务一年之际，京东已经与智元、云深处、众擎、松延动力等近百家机器人企业达成售后维修服务合作，涵盖几乎所有头部机器人企业。
京东对外公布机器人售后相关规划，未来5年，计划创造超过10万个机器人维修工程师的就业岗位，搭建面向全球的机器人维保服务网络。
与此同时，京东还将持续推进以快递员为代表的物流一线员工转型机器人维修工程师，通过系统化培训与实战历练，打造一支高素质、专业化的机器人维修队伍，助力一线员工职业转型。（快科技）
国际资讯
OpenAI 将研发人形机器人，奥尔特曼称核心是打造“大脑”
10 月 18 日消息，尽管 OpenAI 已经忙于开发人工智能模型和全新消费级硬件，但首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼及其团队显然还有精力推进另一个项目：人形机器人。奥尔特曼在播客节目中解释，选择人形具备合理性，原因是“这个世界本身就是为人类设计的”。
被问到 OpenAI 是否会亲自制造人形机器人时，他的回答十分简洁：“我们会。”不过奥尔特曼并不十分在意机器人外观这类细碎细节。他称，这些问题“远不如真正研发出驱动机器人运转的‘大脑’重要”。简单来讲，如果一台机器不知道如何运用四肢，就算给它装上双臂双腿，也难以发挥作用。据了解，该项目距离成为正式产品还有很长一段路。奥尔特曼此前曾表示：“我预计我们会在 2027 年拿出亮眼的演示样机…… 但机器人走上街头还需要再等好几年。”（IT之家）
英特尔陈立武：美中芯片各有优劣势，差距没想象大
10月18日消息，英特尔CEO陈立武在接受专访时指出，美国政府虽然在英特尔持有少数股权，但对公司治理并无任何影响。他还提到，英特尔的重组工作已完成8成，至于美中芯片差距并没有想象中那么大。
陈立武强调，美国政府并没有利用其少数股权干预英特尔的商业策略，并坚称公司依然保有独立性。去年，美国政府将此前拨付的联邦资金转为对英特尔89亿美元的投资，从而获得该公司9.9%的股权。今年8月，英特尔进行二次股票发行后，美国政府持股比例被稀释至约8.2%。
谈到中国大陆半导体业的发展时，陈立武认为，美国与中国大陆企业“有各自的优劣势”。然而，当被问及中国大陆芯片制造能力能否在5到10年内追上美国时，他说：“就目前而言，我认为差距并不大。”（快科技）
RTX 5090真要停产停售吗：英伟达回应了！
10月17日消息，近日，英伟达个人计算业务高级副总裁Jeff Fisher在出席活动时，专门正面回应了近期流传的RTX 5090停产相关传闻，直接明确表示相关消息完全不属实。他特意强调，RTX 5090目前仍是英伟达产品线里非常重要的核心旗舰级消费级产品，后续品牌会继续面向全球市场稳定供货。
不过他也同时承认，当前这款显卡的供应链产能确实受到不小限制，英伟达正在全力协调资源推动产品尽快补满市场供需。这位高管直言，如果早年没有深耕游戏显卡业务、没有推出GeForce系列产品线，就不会有今天的英伟达。此前，英伟达美国官方官网悄然下架了RTX 5090旗舰显卡的商品页，进一步加剧了外界关于它已经全面停产、甚至英伟达要直接把高端消费级产品线砍掉的各类猜测。据统计，国内32GB版RTX 5090的价格从9月初的约3.5万元涨至10月14日的5.4万元左右，涨幅超过50%。德国市场均价超过6000欧元，较一年前暴涨132%。（快科技）
马斯克盯上了砍价生意，号称一年为全球省下6万亿美元
10月18日消息，当地时间10月16日，特斯拉创始人马斯克在社交平台发文称，团队正投入大量资源，开发面向商业场景的专用议价机器人（Hagglebot）。
马斯克表示，“我们认为该产品能够将企业成本效率提升5%乃至更高。如果放到全球GDP的维度测算，每年可节省的成本规模最高可达6万亿美元。”他还进一步指出，凡是使用Grok的企业，都能获得立即可量化的竞争优势。需要注意的是，Hagglebot只是依托Grok打造的软件AI Bot，并不是Optimus那种实体人形机器人。它主打企业议价场景，和普通对话AI定位完全不同。目前马斯克没有放出太多细节，这套AI具体怎么议价、支持哪些交易场景、何时上线、怎么收费，都还没有官宣。另一边，特斯拉的实体人形机器人Optimus擎天柱，仍在小批量内部试产。（快科技）
AI 编程神器出事了！OpenCode 遭入侵，API 密钥恐泄露
10 月 18 日，开源 AI 编程工具 OpenCode 披露，发生一起与大规模模型蒸馏攻击有关的安全事件，影响了约 1.4% 的 OpenCode Console 用户。OpenCode Console 是该项目提供的在线服务，与本地运行的 OpenCode 编程工具有所区别。此次事件涉及关联了外部 AI 模型服务商账户的部分 Console 用户，并非所有 OpenCode 用户。
根据受影响用户公开的通知邮件，OpenCode 发现一套正在停用的旧系统遭到未经授权访问，保存在用户工作区中的第三方 AI 服务 API 密钥可能泄露，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic 等服务商的密钥。
OpenCode 表示，目前尚无法确认相关密钥是否遭到恶意使用，初步调查也未发现其他数据泄露的证据。其还在与相关 AI 服务商讨论异常费用的退款问题，但尚未作出退款承诺。与此同时，部分用户反映出现异常 API 使用情况。其中一名用户表示，收到 OpenCode 的安全通知时，还收到了 Anthropic 发来的邮件，显示其当月 20 美元的 API 额度已经耗尽。目前，安全事件仍在处理中，OpenCode 正与 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 合作开展补救工作。（云头条）

articles.title: 韩财长喊话半导体景气到2027年！韩媒泼冷水：2029年存储芯片将成红海
articles.text:
快科技10月19日消息，据报道，韩国企划财政部部长李炯日近日在曼谷出席IMF与世界银行年会期间接受采访时表示，全球半导体市场强劲增长势头至少延续至2027年，理由是半导体供需缺口仍然巨大，且供给端仍在持续扩张。
然而，韩国《每日经济》日前发表的专栏给出了截然不同的时间表。专栏援引首尔大学教授黄哲成的判断称，2028年之前是安全区，2029年起新建产能将集中释放，存储市场将转为红海。到2030年，超级周期可能结束，产业进入下行阶段。
专栏列出的风险清单包括AI投资速度调整、美国长期国债收益率逼近6%，以及中国长鑫存储与韩国的技术差距已缩小至1至2年。
特斯拉CEO马斯克也在X平台回应称，中国将在2028年大量生产RAM，被解读为对中国存储产能冲击的侧面印证。
值得一提的是，两种叙事并不必然矛盾。存储产能从投资到量产通常有2至3年的滞后期，2027年的繁荣与2029年的过剩完全可以同时成立。
目前，三星2026年产能扩张约50%，SK海力士基础设施投资增至原计划4倍，厂商都在赌在过剩到来前收回投资。
SK海力士2026年第二季度营业利润同比增长557.2%，管理层重申需求到2030年都将超过供给。TrendForce集邦咨询预测，2027年HBM价格将较2026年上涨121%，全球存储市场规模有望突破1.28万亿美元。
不过，关于存储芯片行业繁荣与过剩的赛跑，答案或将在未来几个季度的财报与资本开支数据中逐步揭晓。

articles.title: Datacenters 2027: The Year of Acceleration, +50GW in a Single Year
articles.text:
Not a week goes without another piece of datacenter FUD. We’ve already debunked  in depth why moratoriums aren’t as impactful as one may think. Despite that, many still misunderstand the pace of the global AI datacenter buildout. Just the other week, Brad Gerstner from Altimeter showed our data on the All-In Podcast and stated that “SemiAnalysis’ forecast of +43GW in 2027 is too aggressive” and that he thought only about 25GW would get built, close to half of our number, based on his “hunch”. But let’s not operate on hunches.
It’s very tempting to cede to the FUD given all the constraints on the datacenter buildout: power, labor, supply chains, capital, and many more. But at SemiAnalysis, we care about the truth, not about narratives. And here’s the truth for you: one picture, >24GW of datacenters in advanced stage of construction, most of it to be delivered in 2027. Most of them are more than halfway done, with exterior cooling and electrical equipment already installed. That’s just 40 campuses, a tiny share of the multiple hundred sites in advanced stage of construction. We track them all, and for the full granularity, use our Datacenter Industry Model.
Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Industry Model
Of course, there are plenty of challenges and shortages. Behind these pictures, there are labor issues, supply chain delays, fundraising challenges, among many others. We’ve written in-depth about Modular Datacenters and Labor, Datacenter Electrical systems, Cooling systems, Behind-The-Meter power, the US Grid Constraints, and Nvidia’s ecosystem financial support. But the fact is simple: gigantic sites are simply getting built, and many are on time. For example, just go look at what Crusoe built in Abilene, what AWS built in Indiana, or QTS/Microsoft’s giant site in Georgia. These are the sites that have produced SOTA technology like GPT-6 and Fable 5.5. Looking ahead, despite all the constraints, an accelerating number of giant sites keep getting built, as shown by our Top 40 picture
Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Industry Model
If you ask any datacenter builder, they’ll tell you how hard it is, how some workers aren’t showing up, how vendors are delayed, and many other issues. All of this is accurate. And that’s why we’ve successfully called out countless datacenter delays and keep calling out developer timelines that appear overly aggressive in our Datacenter model, including the Oracle New Mexico Force Majure site delay in April. To be fair, +50GW is essentially the global cumulative datacenter market up through 2024 being built in one year! But our Datacenter Industry Model adjusts for all of that and still points to a material acceleration in datacenter capacity in 2027. So, what are we seeing that others can’t?
Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Industry Model
SemiAnalysis is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support our work, consider becoming a subscriber.
Let’s dig in. We’ll explore the following topics in this report:
SemiAnalysis proprietary leading indicators: we’ll show a sneak peak of our proprietary data supporting our forecast, such as self-build construction starts and datacenter leasing (in MWs and USD). Year-to-date, slightly under USD 1T of binding / non-cancellable datacenter leases have been signed – that’s key to supporting our aggressive 2027-28 forecast.
The shape of the buildout: how can we support +50GW in a single year? Where, what design, what power solutions?
The “real” question: are we going to face a datacenter oversupply? As we explained in The Great Silicon Shortage, datacenters & power may be the tip of the iceberg, with memory and logic possibly becoming the new #1 constraint in 2027-28.
Overall, we are very excited about 2027. The natural implication of the acceleration will be significantly more compute supply. That means cheaper and smarter AI, faster pace of AI model progress, and likely material revenue acceleration for leading AI labs and other token vendors. That also means unthinkable capex numbers. Reflexively rates will have to shoot up to enable the buildouts from a capital demand perspective. Let’s dive in!
SemiAnalysis Datacenter Leading Indicators: how we see the buildout before everyone else
Today we want to dive into two crucial indicators that give us strong confidence on our 2027 forecast. The first one is quarterly self-build construction starts. To accurately forecast US hyperscalers, we track the exact construction evolution of every single building. And the conclusion is simple: US hyperscalers have never launched more construction of datacenters. Each quarter, we track how many MWs start construction, and that number is going parabolic, driven in particular by two hyperscalers. If you want to know who or track the granularity of our data, subscribe to our Datacenter Industry Model.
Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Industry Model
The second indicator is Datacenter Leasing. We’ve talked about this a lot in prior reports, but as a quick recap: given the capital-intensity of building multi hundred MW datacenters, developers typically only spend 5-10% of project capital without a customer. They need a “pre-lease” to fund and develop the whole project. That’s typically a 15-20 year contract, with a TCV of $30-50B per GW. Check out our HPC Lease Tracker as part of the Datacenter Model to dive into actual contract economics.
Subscribe now
As such, tracking these lease contracts is a key leading indicator, as it leads debt raises, which itself leads the actual buildout. A big reason why 2026 datacenter growth isn’t “that” high relative to 2025, is that quarterly datacenter leasing remained relatively stable between H2 2023 and H1 2025. Of course, the key reason was the Microsoft Datacenter Freeze, which we called out before anyone else in December 2024 for Datacenter model subscribers: the Redmond giant single-handedly drove the leasing market in 2023 and 2024, then paused, and others could only pick up what was left behind.
Since H2 2025, things have dramatically changed. Oracle kicked off the era of gigantic leases, after closing on ~4.5GW of datacenter IT capacity across three sites between August and October 2025. Everyone else followed, and the pool of buyers has never been broader, with Meta, AWS, Microsoft, Google, Nvidia, AMD, Anthropic and OpenAI all being in the market for GW-scale leases. There’s also a long tail of Neoclouds signing hundred-MW-scale deals.
In USD terms, this means an unprecedented amount of lease value that builders can use to raise debt. Just in 2026 year-to-date, we’ve identified over a trillion USD of lease value that was signed and closed. That trillion is supporting a gigantic datacenter buildout in 2027-28. Our new Compute, Capital & Markets Model is now tracking all the debt raises and can confirm that most of this debt has been raised.
Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Industry Model
The shape of the buildout: how to build 50GW in a year
Tracking all of these leading indicators has enabled us to forecast, before anyone else, the upcoming surge in orders for many industrial suppliers like Vertiv, ABB, Sterling Infrastructure. Check out our Industrials Model for in-depth coverage. However, the challenge is now going from orders to delivery. And resources have obviously become constrained, as power, labor, and sheer regulatory overhead are enormous burdens for developers. But the industry has promptly reacted with innovation.
The first step is to simplify datacenter designs. We show below how Google has modularized their electrical architecture, removing a significant amount of outdoors cabling that requires onsite assembly, replacing them with prefabricated electrical modules. We track all the equipment changes (including suppliers) for datacenter designs and forecast orders in our Industrials Model
Source: SemiAnalysis Industrials Model
Others have opted for more radical design changes. One example is Meta with its tent design, that we exclusively unveiled over a year ago. Another one is AWS which has materially simplified their shell design and launched a new rapid design dubbed “SAMDC”. Data halls are also increasingly prefabricated, an effort called Project Houdini at AWS. Construction timelines are now under 10 months. Hence our “LEGO Datacenters” title for the modular movement, you literally slot them in and go, and doing so allows for MEP labor (7-11 months of work) to drop up to 63%! We will have a full deep dive on the labor of the 2027 buildout coming soon.
Source: SemiAnalysis Industrials Model
In addition to hyperscale selfbuild, datacenter developers promoting prefabricated designs have also been remarkably successful. DayOne is likely the best example. With a total of ~3GW leased since their first deal in early 2023, the Singaporean company has been a rocket ship in terms of construction speed. While traditional developers have >18 months build timelines, DayOne cut this to ~9 months, which was key to signing huge deals with Firmus, OpenAI and Nvidia.
Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Industry Model
Subscribe now
Another core issue is power, and again we think the issue is largely solved. We’ve been the first to talk about all issues on power, since March 2024 and subsequently given the grid headroom dips negative at the end of 2027. This ended up driving AI Labs and hyperscalers to build their own power plants, better known as Behind-the-meter generation, bypassing 5-10year grid interconnection timelines. And while turbine incumbents like GEV quickly faced production bottlenecks, the industry quickly reacted and we’ve since seen a surge in new OEMs and new solutions supplying the market. From fuel cells to truck engines to refurbished turbines, the power generation problem has broadly been solved.
Source: SemiAnalysis Energy Model
In addition, the buildout is now geographically diversifying. This naturally bypasses US labor, power, and (in some countries) permitting constraints. And as shown below, the ex-US buildout is sharply accelerating in 2027, and we expect it to gain a lot of market share in 2028, largely driven by US challenges.
Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Industry Model
The Real Question: Will We Have an Oversupply of Datacenters?

articles.title: Who judges the judge? Three helpful ways to audit your LLM evaluators
articles.text:
Is your LLM-as-a-judge truly objective?
There’s a common misconception in tech that humans are subjective, so we should rely on AI for objective evaluation. But the reality is that LLMs are also subjective. Just like human reviewers, they can carry biases:
Verbosity bias: LLM judges usually favor longer, confident-sounding answers, even when the underlying facts are wrong.
Position bias: Swapping the order of two options can cause an LLM judge to flip its verdict over 75% of the time.
The halo effect: Because LLMs generate text piece by piece, clean grammar and formatting can trick an AI judge into giving top marks for accuracy while missing errors.
Agreeableness bias: LLM judges are great at recognizing valid work. But with detecting errors, they may fail to catch incorrect, buggy, or unsafe outputs up to 75% of the time.
Self-enhancement bias: Also known as egocentric bias, AI evaluators systematically overrate outputs that were generated by themselves or from their own family.
Ultimately, LLM judges are not objective arbiters of truth. They are subjective models with their own distinct biases. Treating them as infallible tools that don't need their quality measured might leave your work compromised.
In this post, we’ll explore what’s holding enterprises back from strong evals, and share an easy three-pillar method you can use to improve your quality.
Three helpful ways to audit your LLM judges
Pillar 1: Measure internal stability
Before you can trust an AI judge’s score, you need to know that it isn't just guessing. Because LLMs are probabilistic, they can be inconsistent, giving different scores to the exact same text.
You can test this internal stability by running multi-pass consistency checks on a single output and calculating the variance. If a judge's scores fluctuate wildly on identical inputs, its rubric is too ambiguous.
Pillar 2: Validate human alignment
When your evaluation datasets are mostly valid responses, a lenient AI judge can look great on paper. It might align closely with human reviewers overall, but miss a majority of invalid or even unsafe outputs.
To prove your LLM judge is catching real errors, you need chance-corrected metrics. These mathematical models filter out agreements driven purely by leniency or random chance, showing how closely your evaluator actually aligns with the informed decisions of human experts.
Pillar 3: Use multi-judge ensembles
To avoid the halo effect mentioned earlier, teams should use decomposed prompting. Instead of asking one LLM judge to score an entire response, assign a specialized judge to evaluate a single criteria, like factual accuracy or tone. This isolates traits and forces independent scoring.
Second, to track performance in real time without human intervention, the established best practice is ensembling. This means running at least two different models under the hood to evaluate the exact same output simultaneously.
By finding the statistical consensus between these models, you can flag if their evaluations begin to diverge and avoid any scoring quality degradation.

articles.title: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
articles.text:
This week, Character.AI declared bankruptcy. While some saw the fall of a chatbot platform as a harbinger for the industry, court filings indicate that the decision was actually a key part of a deal that has let Disney hire most of Character.AI’s staff—including its now former CEO Karandeep Anand—potentially acquire most of Character.AI’s technology, and avoid the beleaguered startup’s many legal liabilities and obligations.
In the past few years, Character.AI has faced multiple private lawsuits over the safety of its chatbots, as well as investigations from regulators around the world. In a declaration filed as part of the bankruptcy, Character.AI’s newly appointed CEO explained that the goal of the bankruptcy was to reach a “consensual resolution” with personal injury claimants and a group of states investigating the company, while maximizing the value of the company’s assets for shareholders.
The Disney deal seems to be structured so that whatever is left of Character.AI will retain responsibility for those legal battles, some of which are still ongoing.

articles.title: OpenAI 三个神秘模型曝光；DeepSeek 开放搜索与网页抓取 API；智界将获独立造车资格，公司计划上市 ｜ 极客早知道
articles.text:
OpenAI 三个神秘模型曝光
10 月 18 日，有开发者发现，OpenAI 的 API 模型列表中突然出现了三个陌生名字：
aurora-red-alpha、aurora-green-alpha、aurora-blue-alpha。三个模型都以 Aurora（极光）命名，分别对应红、绿、蓝三种颜色。但相关条目很快便从模型列表中消失。
此次发现来自第三方维护的 OpenAI 模型列表镜像，并非官方公告。因此，这些模型究竟是什么、是否会正式发布，目前都还是未知数。
有网友推测，这些模型极有可能是 GPT-6 Astra 后续版本的内部检查点，专门对标 Fable 5.5 的强项，创意编码、长程 agent、视觉 / 3D。也有网友推测：三个模型对应 OpenAI 三个图像模型。（消息来源：机器之心）
Anthropic 与法律专家讨论 AI Agent 谈判规则，未来可替用户砍价、处理纠纷
据《金融时报》最新报道，Anthropic 正在与律师事务所及法律专家合作，研究 AI Agent 代表用户进行谈判时应遵循的行为规范。
随着 Agent 逐渐能够独立执行任务，未来可能出现大量 AI 与 AI 之间的商业交互。
例如，消费者让自己的 AI 助手与商家的 AI Agent 讨价还价，员工让 AI 代理参与薪资谈判，或者用户委托 AI 处理服务纠纷。
Anthropic 希望明确几个问题：AI 应该在多大程度上争取用户利益？什么时候需要征求用户确认？面对其他 AI Agent 时，是否应该默认对方存在欺骗或操纵意图？
公司还讨论过一种授权方式：让用户通过签署文件，明确 AI 的代理权限、目标和行为边界。
目前，这仍属于规则研究和产品探索，尚未推出面向公众的自动谈判服务。（消息来源：金融时报）
DeepSeek 正式开放搜索与网页抓取 API，每千次调用收费 5 元
DeepSeek 正式开放 Search 和 Fetch 两项 API，向开发者提供基于自研搜索引擎的网页搜索及内容抓取能力。
其中，Search API 可以根据关键词返回结构化搜索结果，包括网页标题、链接、摘要、发布日期等信息；Fetch API 则可以抓取指定网页，将正文转换为 Markdown 文本。
两项 API 均采用按成功请求次数计费的方式，价格为每千次 5 元。失败、超时或未返回有效结果的请求不收费。
DeepSeek 还为接入其 API 的 Claude Code、Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness 提供了阶段性的免费搜索调用安排。
DeepSeek 表示，其自研搜索引擎目前每天在全球范围内处理数亿次请求。（消息来源：DeepSeek 官方公告）
Anthropic 拟设立「公共利益」基金，初始注入 5% 股份
当地时间 10 月 18 日，Anthropic 宣布，在获得股东批准的前提下，公司计划将 5% 的股份划入新设立的公共利益基金（Public Benefit Fund）；且随着这家人工智能巨头的估值增长，该基金持有的股份比例未来还可能进一步提升。
该拟议的基金将作为一家全资拥有的有限责任公司设立，经董事会裁量，公司估值每较尚未披露的基准上涨 50%，基金就会获得 Anthropic 额外 2% 的股份。
Anthropic 公共利益基金所支持的项目将涵盖非营利捐赠、向特定群体发放直接资助，以及应对人工智能对就业人员冲击等举措。
该公司表示，该基金所持有的任何股权均不会用于美国国内或海外的政治游说与政治捐赠。
Anthropic 表示，将于未来数月内公布有关该基金治理机制、组织结构以及可能扩大其持股比例的估值门槛的更多细节；此外，公司还计划发布一份公共利益报告，详细披露其实现使命的进展。（消息来源：IT 之家）
苹果首次公布折叠屏 iPhone Duo 电池容量：4883mAh 由两块电池组成
苹果公司近日公布的欧盟产品信息文件揭示了首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 的电池容量。这款设备配备总容量为 4883mAh 的电池，由两块电芯组合而成，容量分别为 2962mAh 和 1921mAh。相关信息此前已在网络上出现，此次欧盟产品信息文件的发布进一步证实了这一数据。
对于一款采用书本式折叠设计的手机而言，4883mAh 的容量反映了苹果在机身厚度、铰链结构、屏幕尺寸和电池空间之间所作的取舍。折叠屏手机需要将内部空间分配给两块显示屏、铰链、主板、摄像头及其他组件，同时还必须在展开和折叠状态下维持合理的机身厚度。与传统直板手机相比，这种结构设计会给电池布局带来更多限制。
iPhone Duo 采用双电池系统，两块电芯分别位于机身的两个部分。苹果此前表示，iOS 会将这两块电池作为一个整体进行管理，而不是让用户分别操作。采用两块电池有助于适应折叠机身的内部空间布局，但这并不意味着两块电池的容量相同，也不能仅凭电芯数量判断整机的续航表现。
苹果公布的续航数据也显示，使用哪块屏幕会显著影响电池表现。根据苹果此前公布的规格，iPhone Duo 在展开状态下使用 7.6 英寸内屏播放视频，最长续航时间为 31 小时；仅使用 5.4 英寸外屏播放视频时，最长可达 44 小时。按照苹果定义的典型使用场景，设备的续航时间最长为 24 小时。该典型使用场景假设用户均衡使用内外两块屏幕，同时进行消息收发、拍照、音乐播放、社交应用、视频流媒体、游戏、网页浏览和导航等操作。( 消息来源：cnBeta)
智界将获独立造车资质 内部人士确认公司计划上市
工信部 10 月 16 日公示《道路机动车辆生产企业及产品公告》（第 412 批），公告显示，安徽智界新能源汽车有限公司（下称「智界」或「智界汽车」）列入「拟发布新准入车辆生产企业」清单，公示期至 10 月 23 日。随后，「智界拿到独立造车资质」的消息随即扩散。
后智界汽车内部人确认，智界汽车在公示结束获批后将取得独立造车资质，「是奇瑞的工厂给到了智界」，该人士还同步确认了智界汽车未来计划独立上市的信息。（消息来源：第一财经）
医用外骨骼康复纳入多地医保，2025 年中国市场规模达 14.2 亿元
10 月 18 日消息，国家医保局印发的《全民医疗保障「十五五」规划》提出，积极将新技术、新药品、新器械应用纳入商业健康保险保障范围。央视财经记者近日走访了解到，目前北京、上海、江苏、浙江等多地，已将「医用外骨骼康复训练」项目纳入医保或长护险试点。
报道称，医用外骨骼，是一种可穿戴的智能康复机器人，能够为患者提供标准化、重复性的步态训练，针对髋、膝、踝关节的运动控制、躯干平衡和步态控制进行训练，帮助患者重新建立站立、迈步和行走的能力。过去，医保报销的康复训练多由康复师人工辅助完成，医用外骨骼康复训练项目纳入医保后，患者有了更多选择。
当前，医院康复科、康复专科医院及康复中心仍是主要应用场景。受人口老龄化、康复医疗需求增长、基层康复体系建设及国产替代推动，医疗康复外骨骼成为商业化成熟度最高的细分市场。
2025 年，中国消费助力外骨骼机器人市场规模接近 1.1 亿元，出货规模约 1.9 万台。随着人口老龄化、银发经济发展以及产品成本下降，正加速向日常助行、户外运动和文旅体验等场景拓展，成为市场增长的重要动力。( 消息来源：IT 之家 )
开源项目 Husk 2.0 公布：利用自研翻译层让苹果 iPhone 运行 Android 游戏，兼容超 150 款应用
10 月 18 日消息，独立开发者 Leviidev 近期公布了 Husk 2.0 开源项目，利用自研翻译层，让部分 Android 应用自带的 64 位原生代码能够直接在 iPhone 处理器上运行，相应项目无需越狱 iPhone，支持 iOS 16 及以上系统，目前已兼容超过 150 款应用。
Husk 2.0 与传统 Android 模拟器有所不同。以 QEMU 等方案为例，传统模拟器通常需要模拟完整的 Android 系统，包括启动系统、加载内核和运行系统服务。而 Husk 则通过翻译层绕过完整系统环境，将游戏的 DEX 文件及 .so 动态库加载到普通 iOS 应用进程中，再由自身提供游戏所需的 Android 运行环境。
在兼容性方面，Husk 2.0 支持 iOS 16 及以上版本，可导入 APK、XAPK、APKM 和 APKS 格式的安装包，也能处理 Google Play 商店使用的分割安装包。项目支持 Unity、Unreal Engine 4、Godot 3 和 Godot 4 等游戏引擎，同时兼容 cocos2d-x、SDL2 和 SDL3，甚至能够运行经典游戏《GTA：圣安地列斯》。
不过，「免越狱」安装并不意味着安装过程简单。Husk 依赖即时编译（JIT）功能，而 iOS 对 JIT 权限有严格限制，通常需要通过调试器等方式授予。在用户成功启用相应功能后，需要通过侧载方式部署 Husk，同时目前 Husk 一次只能运行一款应用，用户切换游戏时需要完全关闭并重新启动 Husk，本身具有一定门槛，仅适合爱好者尝鲜体验。（消息来源：IT 之家）
十万级大众用上激光雷达！新款与众 06、07 上市：9.99 万起
10 月 18 日消息，大众安徽新款与众 06、与众 07 已上市，两款新车同时新增大容量电池，续航能力得到升级。
价格方面，与众 06 一共推出 3 款车型，官方售价区间 12.99‑16.99 万元，其中 Lite 版双十一惊喜价 11.99 万元。
与众 07 推出 4 款车型，官方售价区间 10.99‑14.99 万元，Lite 版双十一惊喜价低至 9.99 万元。
与众 06：轿跑 SUV 定位 主打运动风格。
智能驾驶是本次升级重点，与众 06 搭载地平线征程 6H 智驾芯片，算力 420TOPS，全车拥有 25 颗感知硬件，包含 1 颗激光雷达、11 颗高清摄像头（含两颗 800 万像素前摄）、12 颗超声波雷达以及 1 颗毫米波雷达。
与众 07 定位溜背纯电轿跑，设计兼顾轿跑车的流畅线条与车内头部空间。
智驾硬件配置和与众 06 保持一致。此外，与众 07 还提供纯视觉、激光雷达两套智驾方案供用户选择。（消息来源：快科技）
轴距加长至 2.8 米！比亚迪第三代秦 PLUS 实车曝光
10 月 18 日消息，近期，比亚迪第三代秦 PLUS 实车曝光，这款新车已经完成工信部申报。按照规划，新车有望在 10 月下旬正式和消费者见面。
此前，王朝网销售事业部总经理路天就对该车进行过预热，用「尺寸更大，空间更大，想象更大」概括第三代秦 PLUS 的核心升级点，也让不少消费者对这款家用轿车充满期待。
从申报资料可以看到，本次曝光的秦 PLUS EV 纯电版本车身规格迎来明显升级。整车长宽高分别为 4840mm、1900mm、1498mm，轴距提升到 2800mm，将直接改善车内后排乘坐空间，整车定位向着更高一级别的家用轿车靠拢。
动力层面，新车搭载型号为 TZ164XYD 永磁同步电机，由抚州比亚迪负责生产制造，电机峰值功率可达 100kW，额定功率 40kW。（消息来源：快科技）
费城女子因阻拦送餐机器人被捕
美国费城一名女子因多次阻挡一台 Uber 送餐机器人前进并拒绝离开其行进路线，最终被警方逮捕，并被指控扰乱公共秩序。这起事件被现场视频记录下来，在社交媒体和媒体报道推动下迅速引发广泛关注。
被捕女子名为卡罗琳·马文（Carolyn Marvin）。她在接受当地媒体采访时表示，自己之所以长期阻拦送餐机器人，是因为认为这些自动化设备正在取代人类送餐员的工作机会。
马文表示，她每当在街头看到送餐机器人时，都会站到其前方阻止其继续前进。她认为，自动配送技术的发展正在削弱依赖送餐工作的劳动者生计，因此希望通过公开抗议的方式引发社会关注和讨论。
事发当天，警方接到报警后赶到现场，并要求马文离开机器人的行进路线。然而她拒绝服从警方要求，最终被戴上手铐带离现场，并被控扰乱公共秩序。整个过程被拍摄下来，随后在网络上传播。
事实上，当地此前已经出现多起针对送餐机器人的敌对事件。自今年早些时候 Uber 与自动配送公司合作将送餐机器人引入费城市中心以来，这类设备已经成为当地街头越来越常见的存在，而围绕它们的争议也持续升温。
根据其他当地媒体披露的信息，马文现年 78 岁，曾在宾夕法尼亚大学任教。她表示自己是在行使宪法第一修正案赋予的言论和抗议权利，并计划对相关指控提出抗辩。（消息来源：cnBeta）

articles.title: Learning User Representations to Improve Simulation Fidelity
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22518v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: User simulators enable interactive training and evaluation of AI assistants at scale. Yet current simulators struggle to reproduce the diverse behaviors of real users, leading to assistants that generalize poorly to underrepresented users. We identify user representations as an underexplored bottleneck in user simulation. User representations are natural-language descriptions that condition simulators to reproduce a particular user's behavior. A representation's quality becomes apparent in hindsight, through the behavior it induces in a simulator. To evaluate and optimize user representations, we formulate a conversation reconstruction task: given an original conversation, we generate a representation, condition a simulator on it, simulate a conversation, and then measure fidelity by comparing user behavior in the original and simulated conversations. This comparison also yields hindsight feedback, which identifies where the representation falls short and how it can be improved. We introduce hindsight distillation, an online training procedure that distills feedback-conditioned improvements into the representation generator, enabling it to generate improved representations directly from the original conversation. We present UserRepGen-4B, a representation generator trained with hindsight distillation. Across 700 conversations spanning seven datasets, hindsight feedback helps improve user representations at test time, and UserRepGen-4B generates representations that enable more faithful simulation than those generated by GPT-5.5. Beyond conversation reconstruction, learned representations improve simulation fidelity for unseen tasks, better preserve the population-level diversity of real users, and better distinguish users across conversations.

articles.title: Who Do Perspectivist Models Predict Well? Annotator Agreement, Sparsity, and Performance
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22567v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Successful completion of perspectivist natural language processing (NLP) annotation tasks requires algorithms to be aligned across diverse perspectives in order to predict how different humans will rate text. This work studies how the performance of such algorithms varies for annotators who behave differently than others, either by providing annotations that diverge from others' responses or by providing fewer annotations altogether. To aid with characterizing model performance, we curate the largest collection to date of perspectivist NLP datasets with ordinal annotations. After evaluating multiple classes of perspectivist algorithms across each of the datasets, we model the relationship between individual annotator idiosyncrasy and algorithm performance. In general, we find that algorithms perform better on annotators who tend to agree with others, but that annotator response rate does not have a statistically significant positive correlation with algorithm performance.

articles.title: Dynamo v1.6.0-beam-1.0-501b-dev.1
articles.text:
Release Notes
Dynamo v1.6.0-beam-1.0-501b-dev.1 is an experimental snapshot build with early Reflection Beam-1.0-501B-A23B support on the Dynamo SGLang and vLLM backends. It is not recommended for production and is not a QA-gated release. APIs, behavior, and defaults may change before stable support. Use it for evaluation, testing, and early feedback only.
Summary
Dynamo v1.6.0-beam-1.0-501b-dev.1 serves reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B on Dynamo SGLang and vLLM. The frontend adds a Beam parser family on the unified v2 route and derives a Beam turn grammar for every chat turn, so tool calls, structured answers, and reasoning follow the model's channel format. /v1/completions can now echo the prompt with its logprobs. The vLLM runtime uses vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0-ubuntu2404 and the SGLang runtime uses lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-cu130-runtime (#16702).
Kubernetes recipes cover aggregated and 1P1D disaggregated serving on both backends across H200, B200, B300, GB200, and GB300. Every target uses DFlash2 speculative decoding (block length 8), FP8 KV cache, KV-aware routing, and up to 1M tokens of context, with FP8 weights on H200 and NVFP4 weights on the Blackwell GPUs. The recipes include a shared model-cache PVC and download job, an AIPerf synthetic benchmark, and a recipe page on the docs site under recipes/beam-1.0-501b (#16666, #16677, cherry-picked in #16846).
Release Branch: release/1.6.0-beam-1.0-501b-dev.1, tip ef20f7776f20f6c81f8159063918e086eda308d7 (2026-10-19)
Base Commit: c5773baaa579eac59e84860d31e7273d14308a7c on main (2026-10-14)

About Beam-1.0-501B-A23B
Beam-1.0-501B-A23B is Reflection's Beam 1.0 model, published on Hugging Face as reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-NVFP4 and reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-FP8, with a reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2 draft checkpoint. This build serves it through Dynamo's SGLang and vLLM backends, aggregated or disaggregated, with DFlash2 speculative decoding and up to 1M tokens of context.
Full Changelog
Frontend (Beam Serving)
Beam parser family: Added the Beam parser family on the unified v2 route. The parser resumes in the channel an assistant prefill leaves open, and the Beam route keeps only the model's own stop-token text (#16702).
Beam turn grammar: Every chat turn is constrained by a structural-tag grammar derived from the Beam response template. Forced tool choices stay on the Harmony wire, builtin_tools are declared by name for the 1.0 chat template, and a response_format answer is held in the final channel with its tool arguments framed (#16702).
Request policy: Tools whose strict schema Beam cannot honor are served as non-strict, with one warning per request. preserve_thinking=false is accepted as a no-op, and allow_missing_thinking defaults to true (#16702).
Completions echo: /v1/completions echoes the prompt together with its logprobs (#16702).
Parser crates: Pinned dynamo-renderer 8.1.0 and dynamo-parsers-v2 0.10.0 from frontend-crates at the Beam release revision (ef8f4013, frontend-crates#430) (#16702).
vLLM Backend
Lazy engine-launch imports: The vLLM engine-launch imports load lazily, which the Beam vLLM engine needs, and chat_utils is imported from its new vLLM location when present (#16702).
Recipes
Beam-1.0-501B-A23B recipes: Added recipes/beam-1.0-501b with a shared model-cache PVC and download job, an AIPerf benchmark, and a docs-site recipe page (#16666, #16677, cherry-picked in #16846; recipe folder, recipe guide):
SGLang and vLLM, aggregated and 1P1D disaggregated, on H200 (FP8, 8 GPUs aggregated or 16 disaggregated) and on B200, B300, GB200, and GB300 (NVFP4, 8 GPUs).
DFlash2 block length 8, FP8 KV cache with 64-token pages, and up to 1,048,576 context tokens on every target.
KV-aware routing: SGLang publishes KV events and vLLM uses prediction-based routing. Disaggregated targets move KV between prefill and decode over NIXL, and vLLM targets add native host offload.
An AIPerf synthetic chat benchmark (8,192 input and 1,024 output tokens, streaming, one concurrency point per Job).
Reflection logo: Added the Reflection provider logo to the recipe catalog (#16677).
Getting Started
Deployment is Kubernetes-based (Dynamo Platform + DynamoGraphDeployment). Full steps — namespace, model-cache PVC, Hugging Face download job (target checkpoint plus the DFlash2 draft), DGD apply, and a /v1/chat/completions smoke test — are in the recipe README. The benchmark workflow is in perf/README.md. For gated Hugging Face repositories, add an HF_TOKEN secret reference to the download Job.
Known Issues / Limitations
Experimental snapshot build — not QA-gated; not for production.
The shared-model-cache PVC needs at least 2Ti on a ReadWriteMany storage class; set storageClassName in model-cache/model-cache.yaml before applying it.
Disaggregated targets need GPUDirect-capable RDMA devices on both roles and NIXL/UCX connectivity between them. A TCP fallback works without RDMA, but KV transfer then goes through host memory and the pod network.
vLLM disaggregated targets register the whole KV pool as one memory region. If the NIC rejects it (NIXL_ERR_BACKEND), lower --gpu-memory-utilization; the B300 and GB300 disaggregated profiles already ship at 0.5.
Every target requires the DFlash2 draft checkpoint in addition to the target checkpoint.

articles.title: One Communicator, Three Vendors: Extending the MoA Predictive Theory to a Real NVIDIA+AMD+CPU MPI Ensemble
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22769v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The companion MPI-extension paper validated the first communication-bearing machine-shape ensemble: four NVIDIA A100 ranks and four CPU ranks on one NCSA Delta node under one Open MPI job, reassembled by MPI_Gatherv. This paper extends it to a multi-vendor communicator. A Slurm heterogeneous job spanning Delta's A100 and AMD MI100 partitions places A100, MI100 and CPU ranks (nine in all) under one communicator for the first time. We give the theory (a w_i proportional to 1/t_i weight split for three concurrent realizations; a het-job specification as an admissible directive) and report real results, including what the run exposed: the 1/t split assumes time linear in rows, and this fails for the MI100 rank (6 rows took 597 ms against a linear prediction of 1.6 ms). A launch-geometry model, with predictions recorded before measuring, succeeds for the A100 (time flat from 128 to 3456 rows, stepping at exactly 3520 and 6976) and places the MI100 floor in the key loop; changing its launch settings cut about 600 ms to 14.6 ms and the energy per call at 6 rows by 32x, though the MI100 remains about 95x slower than an A100 at 8192 rows. Controlled reruns show that the companion paper's 8.1x A100 result and 22 ms Gatherv were artifacts of four ranks sharing one GPU under Open MPI's default transport. A key/value-split partition whose message sizes are derived from shapes alone is then run: the ring Allreduce of the 8.5 MB message took 11.3, 16.0 and 15.3 ms against a predicted 11-12 ms, the small Allreduce missed its prediction in every run, and compute times reproduce to about 1% while communication times vary up to 4x between runs. Each idea is introduced with a figure and closed with worked examples.

articles.title: 蚂蚁领投了一家清华系AI创企
articles.text:
智东西
作者 | 程茜
编辑 | 心缘
智东西10月19日消息，今日下午，北京AI金融创企熵简科技宣布完成C轮融资，由蚂蚁集团领投，东方国信与乔贝资本跟投。本轮融资后，蚂蚁集团将与熵简科技在AI金融智能体研发、AI金融垂域模型训练等领域展开深度合作。
熵简科技成立于2017年，主要业务为依托大数据、云计算、人工智能等先进技术，打造全资产、全流程的端到端智能资产管理平台。其公司名称的由来是热力学第二定律中对系统混沌程度的度量“熵”，“熵简”寓意通过AI降低金融投研的复杂度。
根据官方披露，该公司核心管理层均毕业自清华大学。其创始人、CEO费斌杰本科就读于清华大学工业工程系，硕士毕业于五道口金融学院，曾担任嘉实基金TMT行业分析师。
▲熵简科技创始人、CEO费斌杰（图源：熵简科技）
另一位联合创始人、CTO李渔，博士毕业于清华大学电子工程系电子科学与技术专业。
▲熵简科技联合创始人、CTO李渔（图源：熵简科技）
此前，熵简科技披露的融资包含2018年8月完成的近亿元A轮融资，由小米集团领投；2019年完成超亿元B轮融资，由高榕资本领投。据企业信息查询平台企查查，熵简科技此前已完成4轮融资，其余两轮未由公司官宣的为2018年成立初期的天使轮和2021年的B轮融资。
▲熵简科技的融资情况（图源：企查查）
该公司的核心产品为面向金融人士的AI投研平台AlphaEngine ，内置海内外资券商研报、会议纪要、点评资讯的投研知识库。基于此，用户可以搜索和查阅各类行业研报、公告和会议纪要，并通过FinGPT与资料库进行问答。
去年2月，熵简科技用DeepSeek-R1蒸馏了熵简科技的FinGPT模型，当时其调用不到30张GPU、用了2周的时间，将DeepSeek-R1背后600多亿参数所蕴含的深度理解和长程推理能力迁移并蒸馏到FinGPT中，使其具备逻辑推理、因果分析和多步决策能力。
其官方数据显示，AlphaEngine已累计服务于十万余名机构投资者，覆盖9000余家机构。
▲使用FinGPT分析光波导产业（图源：熵简科技）
今年3月，该公司推出金融投研“小龙虾”AlphaClaw，能够独立跑通复杂投研工作流，直接交付Excel表格、回测报告、研报点评等结果。AlphaClaw可以读取保存在本地的电子版《金融炼金术》、《投资最重要的事》等巨著，自动生成索罗斯投资逻辑、霍华德·马克思投资逻辑等Skill。
今年9月，其还推出AlphaEngine机构版，采用本地优先架构，在满足金融机构合规要求的前提下，提供涵盖投研工作全流程的能力。
结语：蚂蚁布局B端投研AI智能体，幻觉与合规仍是门槛
在AI金融领域，ChatGPT引爆的大模型热潮发展至今，不少机构都在推进垂域模型与投研智能体，这些工具集中在文档解析、另类数据处理、信息汇总等面向金融行业人士的AI辅助环节。但这一行业普遍面临数据合规边界、模型幻觉、算法可解释性、付费转化等现实问题。
从熵简科技目前的布局来看，其是具备资管业务背景、并已形成稳定机构客户的垂直科技公司，更容易获得产业资本的支持。蚂蚁集团此次投资熵简，且双方将在AI金融领域展开更多合作，或能为此前长期以C端投资者为主的蚂蚁集团，补上在资管投研B端场景的关键一环。

articles.title: AI 里没有答案的问题，需要一场「深谈」
articles.text:
去年，极客公园创新大会第一次办起「小场深谈」。场子都不大，百人左右围坐在一起。
有些瞬间仍然记忆犹新。
在「超级个体」专场，一位观众站起来。他刚从大厂跳槽到一家小厂，正用 AI 做自己的第一款产品。他向嘉宾说出自己的困惑：我还在打工，做公众号、视频号，早晚会被老板和同事刷到。这个冲突，怎么解？
在「硬控 AI」专场，有人直接向刚刚离职的小米 AI 眼镜负责人提问：如果给你两个亿，你会去做哪种 AI 眼镜？有人继续追问，你觉得豆包手机助手到底是真需求还是伪需求？
在「重塑关系」专场，一位精神科医生，问做陪伴机器人的嘉宾：你是希望它把人带回现实社会的交往，还是给这个家添一个新成员？
这些问题都不「大」，但都很真，带着一个人具体的处境，来自坐在你旁边的人。
有老朋友说，这让他们想起极客公园 17 年前的样子——在借来的索尼探梦地下室里，一群人席地而坐。
如果你参加过去年的「小场深谈」，很可能还记得这种 Vibe。不是发布会式的提问，更像小场子里几个人围坐时，把一个人正在卡住、关心的事摊开来聊。
去年的「小场深谈」，共设置了 4 个主题专场，包涵 12 场深度访谈，数百位观众走进小场，165 个朋友甚至同时买了主舞台和「小场」的票：既听了主会场的趋势判断，也不舍得错过小场里「深谈」的收获。还有超过不少人专程为某一场深谈而来。
大会后的购票调研里，超过六成观众把「话题兴趣」排在首位，为了聊自己真正关心的问题而来。
这让我们确认：在信息过载的时代，有些问题，听 AI 解释一百遍，不如和「最有料的人」当面聊一次。嘉宾谈得尽兴，观众提出高质量的问题，一场访谈变成真正的共同创作。
IF 2026「小场深谈」现场部分精彩瞬间
今年 12 月 5 日、6 日，极客公园创新大会 2027 将在北京举行，主题是「Revaluation 价值，另有答案」。AI 冲击下，价值的标准正在被重新评估。哪些旧经验值得重新审视，哪些新机会正在出现？
最迫切的那些议题，网络上、AI 里都没有现成答案。
因此，在主舞台之外，我们将继续保留「小场深谈」——一个更小、更近、更主动的交流空间：

articles.title: 马斯克：明年向全美国每名儿童赠送SpaceX股票
articles.text:
快科技10月19日消息，SpaceX创始人马斯克在社媒平台X发文称，明年将向美国每名儿童赠送一股其持有的SpaceX股票，而这将是众多赠礼中的第一份。
按照最新股价，SpaceX目前报146.03美元，总市值约1.92万亿美元。
据了解，马斯克持有48亿股SpaceX股票，另有3.5亿股行权价为每股8.40美元的股票期权，使其持股比例达到约38%。
说起SpaceX ，美东时间2026年6月12日，SpaceX正式登陆纳斯达克，这笔IPO创下美股史上最大募资纪录，发行价135美元。
上市首日该股大幅高开，市场一度给到超2万亿美元估值。不过行情随后走弱，7月下旬股价最低下探至108美元附近，较高点近乎腰斩。
最新财报方面，SpaceX将于10月20日盘后披露2026年第三季度业绩；特斯拉则会在10月21日盘后公布财报。
根据SpaceX向美国SEC递交的财报，2026年第二季度公司营收78.14亿美元，同比大增约92%；净亏损5.41亿美元，调整后EBITDA约35亿美元。
期末公司现金、现金等价物及有价证券约1000亿美元，在手积压订单475亿美元。
众所周知，SpaceX核心业务覆盖火箭发射、星链卫星互联网以及AI算力基础设施。
市场近期再度传出SpaceX与特斯拉存在整合预期。巴克莱分析师Dan Levy在10 月中旬提出，两家公司存在合并可能性，讨论方向涵盖AI、机器人、算力基础设施以及Terafab芯片项目。

articles.title: What Shapes Brain Alignment of Large Language Models during Dialogue? Insights from Language Production and Comprehension
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22961v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Brain alignment of large language models (LLMs) offers a way to investigate representational similarities between LLMs and the human brain during language processing. While previous studies have mainly focused on passive language comprehension, little is known about such alignment during dialogue, in which speakers engage in both language production and comprehension. In this study, using fMRI data collected during dialogue, we examine brain alignment during language production and comprehension across LLM layers and brain regions. We assess its association with the intrinsic dimension (ID) of LLM representations and the contributions of several interpretable linguistic and communicative features. Our results reveal distinct patterns of brain alignment between production and comprehension, as well as strong associations with ID in brain regions associated with each processing mode. Furthermore, we show that the contributions of linguistic and communicative features also vary across processing modes, LLM layers, and brain regions.

articles.title: Introducing TorchNeuron: Native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium
articles.text:
Frontier models span language, video and audio, on architectures from dense and mixture-of-experts transformers to diffusion, state-space, world and structure-prediction models. PyTorch is where AI research happens, where the models are defined, and increasingly where production happens too. Researchers want to experiment and innovate, and customers want the performance AWS Trainium offers to enable them to achieve their performance and scale goals. The training and serving libraries are written against PyTorch’s own APIs, and new libraries and new versions ship continuously. Over the last several years, PyTorch made those APIs accelerator-agnostic, with official extension points for registering custom hardware.
Today, to address the growing demand from the developers and research community on Trainium, we are excited to share an even simpler approach to program the chip as a standard PyTorch device, ahead of its open source launch at PyTorch Conference North America on Oct. 20. AWS Trainium is a portfolio of AI chips designed from the ground up for next generation cloud scale AI training and inference. We are announcing TorchNeuron, an open source native PyTorch backend for Trainium, so the model code, the libraries, and the tools you already use run on Trainium. This integration builds directly on the accelerator-agnostic extension points, including the PrivateUse1 device backend and torch.accelerator APIs, created by the PyTorch community.
TorchNeuron supports eager execution for research and debugging including new adaptive eager mode with improved performance, torch.compile for production performance, and the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) for custom kernels, on Trainium2 and Trainium3. Also, with Neuron Explorer, performance engineers use the same torch.profiler to trace execution from framework to hardware, linking every event back to its source line to pinpoint bottlenecks and optimize efficiently. TorchNeuron will be released as open source under Apache 2.0 at github.com/aws-neuron/torch-neuronx, going live as public Beta on Oct. 20.
“PyTorch’s vision is straightforward: developers should have a consistent experience across hardware platforms. Native support for AWS Trainium expands that choice, enabling researchers and engineers to experiment and iterate using the eager execution and distributed APIs they already know. Teams can take advantage of Trainium’s capabilities without reinventing their workflows or leaving the PyTorch ecosystem.” – Jana van Greunen, Director of PyTorch Engineering at Meta
Getting started: Easy device switching
Getting started is straightforward. Run your code on Trainium using the pointer: .to('neuron').
# Run a training loop on Trainium
model = MyModel().to('neuron')   # the only change
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters())
for batch in dataloader:
optimizer.zero_grad()
loss = criterion(model(batch), targets)
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
Modern code written against torch.accelerator, PyTorch’s recommended device-agnostic API, runs unmodified. A compiled model needs the Neuron backend named, once with torch.compiler.set_default_backend("neuron"), after which torch.compile(model) takes it, or per call as torch.compile(model, backend="neuron").
# Run a compiled training loop on Trainium
torch.compiler.set_default_backend("neuron")  # call once, before any compile
model = MyModel().to('neuron')
model.compile()  # no backend argument
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters())
for batch in dataloader:
optimizer.zero_grad()
loss = criterion(model(batch), targets)
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
Capabilities
TorchNeuron registers Trainium through PrivateUse1, PyTorch’s official extension point for custom hardware, so the standard APIs work as written: torch.nn, torch.tensor, torch.autocast, torch.distributed, and torch.profiler all operate on the neuron device. The two execution modes of PyTorch, eager and torch.compile work natively.
High-level architecture diagram of TorchNeuron (details).
Eager
Eager runs operations immediately, so Python control flow, prints, and breakpoints all work with no compile or trace step. This is the mode for research and debugging. Eager mode dispatches operations individually. Executed directly, each operation compiles its own Neuron Executable File Format (NEFF) file, launches it on device, and moves its intermediates through HBM. We are also introducing adaptive eager mode (experimental), to reduce the launch cost and provide better opportunities to fuse operations to approach performance of compiled graph without a code change, while retaining the interactive experience.
torch.compile
torch.compile(model, backend="neuron") captures the model into a graph the Neuron compiler optimizes, and is the mode for stable, high-performance models moving to production. torch.compile can be used to optimize the whole or part of the model and works seamlessly with eager mode. FlexAttention is supported natively. TorchDynamo captures the model into an FX graph, AOTAutograd traces the backward graph ahead of time, the Neuron backend lowers the result, by way of Torch-MLIR, into StableHLO, and the Neuron compiler produces a NEFF file that executes on hardware.
The Neuron inference stacks are built on the same torch.compile support in TorchNeuron. vLLM Neuron is a plugin to vLLM and serves LLMs; vLLM Omni Neuron is a plugin to vLLM Omni and serves diffusion models for image and video generation.
Ops and dtypes
Broad aten operator coverage for ops seen across text, multimodal and vision language, image and video generation and understanding, state space models, and world models. Models can use BF16, FP32, and FP16, with integer and boolean types, and torch.autocast and mixed precision code operate as written. TorchAO and FP8 are currently supported under private Beta and will be made generally available in the next release.
Distributed APIs
Distributed inference and training can use the standard PyTorch APIs and the high-level parallelism modules compose with your model as written: DDP, FSDP2, SimpleFSDP, tensor parallelism, and pipeline parallelism, along with common compositions like FSDP2 with tensor parallelism, ZeRO that are essential for training large models. DTensor and DeviceMesh are supported to handle sharding and the multi-dimensional process groups. The collective APIs (example: all_gather, reduce_scatter, all_reduce) and the P2P APIs (send, recv) are supported. Collectives execute over Trainium’s dedicated collective cores intra-node and over the Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) inter-node, so the communication transport is native to the hardware with no change to PyTorch APIs.
Streams and Events
Torch streams and events are supported natively. torch_neuronx.Stream and torch_neuronx.Event map PyTorch’s stream semantics onto Trainium’s hardware queues. Within a stream, data movement and computation stay in order automatically. Separate streams carry no implicit dependency on one another, so across streams you make that ordering explicit by recording an event on the producing stream and waiting for it on the consuming stream before using the result. The device-agnostic torch.Stream, torch.Event, and torch.accelerator entry points reach the same implementation, so code written against them runs unmodified. An error surfaces at the next synchronization point rather than at the operation that caused it; TorchNeuron tracks the earliest exception and re-raises it there with its original context. In execution, non-default streams multiplex onto a single hardware queue, so they keep ordering, priority, and event semantics but do not each get a dedicated engine; and when host collectives are disabled, a collective issued on a non-default stream keeps its place in that stream’s execution order but runs on the default hardware queue.
Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI)
The Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) lets researchers and developers develop, optimize, and execute custom operators for both eager and torch.compile. Researchers can prototype ideas that require low level hardware control, including new model architectures. Developers can obtain finer performance control beyond Adaptive Eager and torch.compile by calling performance critical NKI kernels directly in model code to replace sequences of standard PyTorch operations (ATen ops).
TorchNeuron also provides Trainium optimized, high-performance operators implemented with NKI and released open source as NKI-lib, covering mainstream LLM and multimodal scenarios for both dense and MoE models, such as FlashAttention and MoE blockwise kernels, which developers can use to improve performance on Trainium. The following example defines and registers a custom NKI operator using the PyTorch recommended register_autograd style:
import torch
import nki
import nki.language as nl
from torch_neuronx import nki_op
# Declaring and implementing NKI kernels
# Note in NKI kernels, the output tensor should be defined as parameter to the kernel
@nki.jit
def sin_kernel(in_ptr0, out_ptr):
input_tile = nl.load(in_ptr0[0:128])
output_tile = nl.sin(input_tile)
nl.store(out_ptr[0:128], value=output_tile)
return out_ptr
# defining cos since it will be used in backward path of sin
@nki.jit
def cos_kernel(in_ptr0, out_ptr):
input_tile = nl.load(in_ptr0[0:128])
output_tile = nl.cos(input_tile)
nl.store(out_ptr[0:128], value=output_tile)
return out_ptr
# after this line, there is no NKI code, just native PyTorch, registering custom ops
@nki_op("mylib::pt_nki_sin", mutates_args={})
def pt_nki_sin(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
out = torch.empty_like(x)
sin_kernel(x, out)
return out
@nki_op("mylib::pt_nki_cos", mutates_args={})
def pt_nki_cos(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
out = torch.empty_like(x)
cos_kernel(x, out)
return out
def pt_nki_sin_backward(ctx, grad):
x, = ctx.saved_tensors
return grad * pt_nki_cos(x)  # cos is derivative of sin
def pt_sin_setup_context(ctx, inputs, output):
x, = inputs
ctx.save_for_backward(x)
# Register backward pass and context function used during autograd for nki_sin
pt_nki_sin.register_autograd(pt_nki_sin_backward, setup_context=pt_sin_setup_context)
if __name__ == "__main__":
x = torch.randn(128, 1, device="neuron", requires_grad=True)
# Forward pass uses sin_kernel
y = pt_nki_sin(x)
# Backward pass, autograd calls uses nki_sin_backward() -> cos_kernel()
loss = y.sum()
loss.backward()
Profiling with TorchNeuron
TorchNeuron integrates with the standard torch.profiler.profile API extended with a NeuronConfig object that controls Neuron-specific data collection. This allows users to capture and correlate traces from framework-level CPU operations (PyTorch dispatch, Python stacks) as well as Neuron runtime and Trainium activity (controlled by NeuronConfig) enabling end to end performance analysis.
Profiles captured can be visualized in the Neuron Explorer UI, where users can trace execution across framework, runtime, and device, jump from any event to the exact source line (source code viewer), navigate the workload through its call hierarchy (hierarchy viewer), and follow dependency chains to see what each stall is waiting on (dependency chain viewer).
Neuron Explorer also emits a Parquet output with per-op and per-engine metrics, so the same data behind the UI can be queried directly or consumed by agents for automated bottleneck analysis. For programmatic access, users can work with the built-in torch.profiler tools. For example, the key_averages table lets users drill down into specific ops and use the sort_by argument to surface the device-side cost of each op, which is useful for identifying hotspots.
Following code snippet shows an example (details):
import torch
from torch.profiler import profile, ProfilerActivity
from torch_neuronx.profiling import NeuronConfig, ProfileMode, NeuronProfiler
# Configure Neuron profiling and pass appropriate path as OUTPUT_DIR
nc = NeuronConfig(
modes=[ProfileMode.DEVICE, ProfileMode.RUNTIME],
profile_output_dir=OUTPUT_DIR,
capture_enabled_for_nc='0',
correlate_device_time=True,
)
# NeuronProfiler.export_trace() places the framework trace
# in the same directory as Neuron system traces
exporter = NeuronProfiler(nc)
device = torch.device('neuron')
x = torch.randn(4, 512, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
weight = torch.ones(512, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
def rms_norm_fn(t):
x_sq = t * t
mean_sq = x_sq.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
rms = torch.rsqrt(mean_sq + 1e-6)
return t * rms * weight
# Profile your workload
with torch.profiler.profile(
activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.PrivateUse1],
experimental_config=nc,
record_shapes=False,
on_trace_ready=exporter.export_trace,
schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=2, warmup=1, active=1),
) as prof:
for step in range(4):
with torch.no_grad():
_ = rms_norm_fn(x)
torch.neuron.synchronize()
prof.step()
# Print the per-op summary, sorted by device time to surface hotspots
print(prof.key_averages().table(sort_by="self_privateuse1_time_total", row_limit=4))
For additional capabilities and features refer to Neuron Explorer documentation.
Customers and partners building on TorchNeuron
TorchNeuron is already in use across startups, enterprises, ML industry partners, and academic institutions: spanning autonomous vehicles, robotics, video generation, speech, telecommunications, healthcare, and geospatial modeling. Below is a snapshot of what teams are building today.
“Cartesia is building intelligence that learns from and interacts with the world the way humans do, starting with conversation. Our pioneering work on state-space architectures like Mamba powers Sonic (text-to-speech) and Ink (speech-to-text), the voice AI models behind conversational experiences that feel truly human. Real conversation demands three things at once: quality (naturalness and accuracy), efficiency (low latency at scale), and steerability. Most solutions deliver one or two. We designed our research and products from first principles to deliver all three, which means we need infrastructure that lets us squeeze maximum performance out of every layer without rewriting our stack. With PyTorch native support on AWS Trainium, we ran our standard inference pipeline with minimal changes to our PyTorch code. Small, fast ops map efficiently through the native path, so we didn’t have to hand-write kernels for them. That lets our team concentrate on writing high-performance NKI kernels for the layers that are called repeatedly and drive end-to-end latency. For real-time voice, every millisecond of network distance matters. Running on Trainium gives helps to put Sonic and Ink close to our customers globally.”
Arjun Desai, Cofounder, Cartesia
“Voice is becoming a first-class modality for AI, and Deepgram processes quadrillions of audio tokens a year for more than 200,000 developers and 1,400 organizations. To meet that demand, we need to scale efficiently while continuing to ship better models. Over a multi-month engagement, the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center helped us port our model to PyTorch Native on AWS Trainium. In the benchmarks we evaluated, Trainium processes about 60% more input audio seconds per dollar than our existing GPU baselines, which helps us bring better models to customers at lower prices. We look forward to supporting future AWS AI chips in our solution.”
Adam Sypniewski, CTO, Deepgram
“Hugging Face is the leading open platform for AI builders, providing free access to over 6 million open models, datasets and applications through PyTorch-powered open-source libraries including Transformers and Diffusers. Until now, taking advantage of AWS Trainium required adapting Hugging Face models with Neuron-specific software and configuration; TorchNeuron makes Trainium a native backend for Transformers and Diffusers, so developers can use familiar model definitions through a fully open-source stack – a practical expression of our commitment to silicon neutrality and compatibility. It’s now easier than

articles.title: NLData2Opt: Benchmarking Parameter Derivation and Prediction for Modeling Optimization Problems from Natural Language and Data
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22889v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Formulating optimization problems from raw inputs of problem descriptions and data is time-consuming and costly. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising way to automate this process, existing benchmarks overestimate their capabilities by relying on idealized inputs where all data is relevant and complete. This diverges from reality, where data-centric reasoning is required to extract, compute, and predict parameters from noisy sources. To address this, we introduce NLData2Opt, a benchmark to evaluate LLMs on the multi-stage reasoning inherent in practical optimization workflows. NLData2Opt decomposes problems into problem descriptions and data, and requires models to (1) extract relevant parameters from data containing misleading attributes, (2) compute missing parameters derived by transforming existing data attributes, and (3) predict unavailable future values from historical observations. Evaluation results show substantial performance decline relative to existing benchmarks, indicating that benchmark progress does not directly translate to formulation accuracy in practical optimization workflows. NLData2Opt is available at https://github.com/sumarivyn/NLData2Opt.

articles.title: A Chinese hacker used AI agents to break into more than 100 company websites
articles.text:
A Chinese-speaking hacker has been observed using artificial intelligence (AI) agents to probe and then gain unauthorized access to more than 100 websites belonging to some extremely well-known companies. From Deere, the farming equipment manufacturer, to SharkNinja, the company behind beloved kitchen appliances, the agents were able to leverage exposed instances of Carin, an open-source AI-powered problem-solving platform that has proven popular among hackers, a Reuters report explains.
This is just the latest example of hackers turning to AI agents in an attempt to level up their attacks on unsuspecting companies and services. Snorre Fagerland, principal threat researcher at the cybersecurity company NorForge, spotted the hacker's antics when observing Carin instances that had been inadvertently exposed.
Fagerland was able to watch multiple hackers go about their business, but the Chinese-speaking hacker was the most prolific, the report says. They targeted businesses based in the United States, Canada, Australia, and Japanese e-commerce sites. Notably, the hacker didn't get into detail when commanding their legion of AI agents. Fewer than 100 Chinese characters were used, yet the agents had attempted ot break into more than 1,200 different websites as of the week ending October 18, 2026.
These agents weren't simply throwing everything at a wall and hoping it stuck, either. Security researcher Fagerland was "impressed" by some of the tactics that had been used. In one case, the AI agents scoured digital records to find infrastructure associated with their target, located a public-facing control panel, identified a weakness, and then leveraged it to force the execution of malicious commands, the Reuters report detailed. "It's ⁠not straightforward to come up with solutions like that," Fagerland told Reuters. "It's not script kiddie stuff."
Vitally, the approach of using AI agents in this way means that they can be given instructions and then left to their own devices. With no supervision required, those commanding the agents are free to turn their attention elsewhere. While SharkNinja told Reuters that the attack only impacted a site used for product support information, the rest of the AI-aided hackers had more luck. One of the hackers monitored by Gargerland stole credit card data, while another tried to steal from a cryptocurrency exchange — although it isn't clear whether they were successful.

articles.title: Identify, Classify, Act: Per-Instruction Controlled Compliance for LLMs over External Data
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22874v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LLMs over external data face a per-instruction tension: a single document or tool return often interleaves legitimate directives with adversarial prompt injections, and the model must follow the former while rejecting the latter. Existing defenses suppress or trust all external instructions, collapsing the safety-utility frontier and forcing a choice between over-refusal and over-compliance. We argue the missing capability is \textbf{per-instruction credit attribution} and formalize it as External-Data Instruction Classification, an identify-classify-act decision over each embedded directive. We propose \textbf{EDIC}, a decomposed reward framework for per-instruction compliance. A scene-grounded pipeline injects mixed beneficial and harmful instructions with counterfactual filtering, while a generative judge is initialized by SFT and refined with GRPO to attribute compliance at the instruction level. The judge then produces a reward that separately encourages beneficial compliance and penalizes harmful compliance for RL training. Across two backbones and five benchmarks, EDIC improves both safety and utility over the strongest prior defense, lifting harmful-rejection by up to 7.7\% and Arena-Hard-Auto utility by 12.5\% on Qwen3-4B. The code repository is hosted at https://github.com/yingyingxia666/EDIC.

articles.title: alkhder at AlexandriaX-2026: Context-Aware English-to-Dialectal Arabic Dialogue Translation with QLoRA-Fine-Tuned NileChat-3B
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22525v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: This paper describes team Alkhder's submission to Subtask 1 of the AlexandriaX-2026 shared task, which asks systems to translate English dialogue turns into thirteen Arabic dialects. We fine-tune NileChat-3B-Base with QLoRA on the Alexandria parallel dialogue corpus, training one set of adapter weights for all dialects. Each turn is translated conditioned on the target country and dialect, the domain, the participant roles, the speaker-addressee gender direction, and the preceding dialogue context. At inference, conversations are translated autoregressively and the model is fed its own previous outputs back as context without using any gold target-side test information. Under the constrained track, using only Alexandria data, it trains in about one hour and translates the private test set in under two hours. The system reaches a country-macro-averaged spBLEU of 20.36 and chrF++ of 36.64 on both tracks.

articles.title: 苹果官宣10月29日举办特别活动！首款触屏MacBook Pro有望发布
articles.text:
快科技10月20日消息，今日，苹果宣布，将于美国当地时间10月28日上午10点（北京时间10月29日凌晨1点）举办新品特别活动。
此次活动将在美国洛杉矶举行，主题为“Pro and tell”，苹果全球营销高级副总裁Greg Joswiak也在社交平台发布了活动预告。
苹果大中华区董事总经理葛越也发布相关消息，并表示：“迫不及待，下周和大家分享Pro级精彩！”
据了解，这将是苹果10月举办的第二场新品活动。
此前10月13日，苹果已经推出HomeView智能家居屏、第二代HomePod mini以及新款Apple TV 4K。
结合目前的爆料，此次活动最值得期待的新品无疑是苹果首款触屏MacBook Pro，预计提供14英寸和16英寸两个版本。
这也意味着，苹果有望打破多年来MacBook不支持触屏的传统，让用户除了键盘和触控板之外，还能直接通过触摸屏幕进行操作。
屏幕也是此次升级的重点。
据悉，新款MacBook Pro将首次采用OLED面板，同时取消现有的刘海屏设计，引入类似iPhone的灵动岛。
不仅如此，新机还将采用重新设计的机身，重量相比现款明显减轻，预计搭载苹果M5 Pro和M5 Max芯片。
除了MacBook Pro，新一代iPad mini也有望在此次活动中亮相。
根据此前爆料，新款iPad mini将从LCD屏幕升级至OLED屏幕，同时调整前置摄像头位置，并采用重新设计的扬声器系统。

articles.title: A Plausible Explanation Is Enough to Mislead Multimodal Judges
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22631v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly serve as judges in training and evaluation pipelines, often assessing answers together with explanations. Although AI judges are sensitive to textual factors, it remains unclear whether ordinary plausible explanations can sway judgments requiring visual verification. We introduce JUPE, a visual-question-answering (VQA)-style benchmark that fixes answers while varying explanations.
Across 14 MLLM judges, ordinary explanations that sound plausible mislead judges, with effects comparable on average to deliberately persuasive arguments. Plain justifications and chain-of-thought rationales reduce rejection of incorrect answers by 12.7 and 13.8 percentage points, respectively. We call this failure plausibility capture. Using signal detection theory, we find a significant mean shift in decision criterion toward acceptance, without a clear change in mean discriminability. Explanations sway judgments across domains, explanation generators, and judging protocols, while tested mitigations offer limited, model-dependent protection. Such shifts can inflate performance estimates when judges evaluate answers with explanations.

articles.title: 宇树们进厂 发现事情没那么简单
articles.text:
没有格斗台，没有赛道，依然是宇树机器人。
10月的上海工博会，8.1H展馆一个不起眼的位置，两台宇树G1机器人站在约30平方米的展区内。一台伸手抓取包裹，将其放到指定位置；另一台手持电动螺丝刀，对准螺孔，完成拧紧动作。
两三米外，优必选的轮式人形机器人Cruzr Y1，正将一侧的纸箱逐个搬起，整齐码放到另一侧。再往前走几步，乐聚将工厂产线1:1搬进展馆，四五台Kuavo 5-W机器人分守不同工位，完成拆垛、搬运、上料等作业。
乐聚机器人
相比其他展会，工博会的具身展台是冷清的，这里没有炫酷的表演，只有一遍遍重复的工业操作。
“现在的工业机器人已经很成熟了，具身智能想进产线，得先找到真正有刚需的场景。”展台前，一位前来考察的工业客户向虎嗅表示。
这也是眼下具身圈的一个缩影。
工业被视为具身智能最具潜力的商业化市场之一，但进入门槛并不低。新玩家既要找到传统自动化的空白，还得过生产节拍、稳定性和成本这几道关。
虎嗅在工博会探访及与多位业内人士交流后发现，工业市场的现实需求，正在倒逼具身智能企业调整产品与技术路线，出现几个值得关注的变化：
1.产线开始走向多构型混合部署。人形、四足、机械臂与AMR按任务分工，单机能力要放进整套生产系统中衡量。
2.通用能力开始与单一本体解绑。暂时收窄“通用机器人”的想象，让本体适配工位，让模型和技能跨设备复用。
3.接触判断和柔性物体操作成为突破口。从精密插接到线束装配，机器人开始挑战需要边感知、边调整动作的工序。
4.部署工具成为产品竞争的一部分。数采、训练和调试被整合进软件平台，下一次进厂能省多少时间和人力，开始检验商业化成色。
更棘手的是，传统工业机器人企业也在拥抱“物理AI”，双方正在抢夺同一片市场。
当具身智能走进工业自动化的腹地，面对拥有成熟产品、客户和渠道的传统机器人企业，新玩家究竟能否站稳脚跟？
产线开始走向多构型混合部署今年的工博会上，一个明显的变化是，不同构型机器人协同作业的展示大幅增多。
一方面，传统工业机器人企业的业务边界正在向外延伸。
越疆就是一个典型代表。这家以协作机器人起家的企业，近年来陆续推出人形机器人ATOM系列、四足机器人Rover X1及双臂机器人等产品。
在其展台，人形机器人负责物料分拣，四足机器人承担转运，协作机械臂完成抓取与装配，多种构型各司其职，协同完成一套生产流程。
看起来，这是一场颇为激进的跨界扩张。但越疆创始人刘培超认为，“这些业务是随着技术积累和客户需求，自然而然生长出来的。”
随着柔性生产需求的增加，单一构型难以覆盖所有工序。工业机器人企业开始将积累多年的运动控制、力控等技术，延伸至移动操作、人形机器人等新形态。
另一方面，传统工业自动化企业开始与具身智能创业公司合作，探索多构型协同落地。
汇川技术联合阿米奥机器人展示了一套钣金件柔性装配方案。面对摆放不规则的零件，机器人自主识别位置、规划抓取路径，再通过双臂协同，结合视觉伺服与力控完成装配。
据阿米奥介绍，这套方案能适配轮式双臂、固定基座等不同构型，并且在客户现场最快3天即可完成部署。
与此同时，汇川技术也计划开放SDK接口、数据采集平台及70多个细分行业的场景资源，将自身的工业经验与具身智能企业的算法能力结合。
这种合作背后，是双方能力的互补。
具身智能创业公司在模型算法、感知决策和灵巧操作等方面积累了新技术，但对工业工艺、客户需求和工程交付的理解仍较为缺乏。而这些恰恰是传统工业机器人厂商和系统集成商的优势。
因此，对于新兴具身智能企业而言，与这些成熟厂商合作，或许是一条更现实的进厂路径。
而对于自动化程度较高的工厂，全面替换现有设备意味着高昂的成本和风险。相比之下，保留成熟设备，让具身智能补齐柔性操作等短板，更容易算清经济账。
当然，从展台演示到真实产线部署，仍有不少工程问题需要解决。但一个趋势已经显现：具身智能想进入工厂，首先要学会成为整条产线的一部分。
通用能力开始与单一本体解绑“很多具身智能企业是拿着锤子找钉子，但工业场景的逻辑是，先找到钉子，再去造锤子。”一位业内人士这样形容两者之间的差异。
过去两年，不少具身智能创业公司从通用机器人出发，先研发本体、训练模型，再寻找应用场景，希望打造一台能够胜任各种任务的机器人。
但工厂的需求远比想象中具体。即便是同样的上下料工序，不同工厂对物料尺寸、操作精度和生产节拍的要求也不尽相同。
这也在推动具身智能企业重新思考产品路线。虎嗅与多家机器人企业交流发现，行业正在形成一个共识：由场景来定义产品形态，而不是拿固定的人形产品去硬套场景。
因此，今年工博会上的人形机器人，正变得越来越没有“人味”。
轮式底盘、可折叠和升降结构越来越常见；末端执行器也不再一味追求灵巧手，而是根据工序更换夹爪、吸盘等工具。为了满足工业搬运需求，一些企业开始推出体型更大、负载更高的产品。
智元展台上，两台体型较大的精灵G2 Max就颇为显眼。它们采用轮式底盘和可升降躯干，配备两条大负载机械臂。
据现场工作人员介绍，G2 Max双臂额定负载38公斤，峰值可达50公斤，垂直作业范围覆盖0.1至2.5米。可以在不同高度间完成料箱抓取、搬运和码垛。
不过，产品形态越来越专用，并不意味着企业放弃了对通用能力的追求。只是这种通用性，开始与人形等单一本体解绑。
部分企业开始尝试另一条路径：硬件根据具体工序调整，底层模型、操作技能和部署工具则尽可能跨设备、跨场景复用。
例如，同样是抓取、搬运任务，双足人形、轮式机器人和机械臂虽然运动方式不同，但在物体识别、任务理解和部分操作技能上存在共性。这些能力有望通过统一模型和软件平台实现迁移，减少重复训练。
当然，跨构型迁移仍面临硬件自由度、控制方式和数据差异等难题。但一个方向正在变得清晰：机器人的身体可以专用，大脑则需要越来越通用。
接触判断和柔性物体操作成为突破口具身智能企业正在根据工厂的需求改造自己。但在产线上，它们真正的机会究竟在哪里？
在工博会现场，多位工业自动化从业者表达了相似的观点：能用传统自动化解决的问题，没必要强行引入大模型。具身智能应该盯住那些尚未被自动化充分覆盖的人工工位。
对于标准化程度高、生产节拍稳定的工序，工业机器人已有成熟方案。但在多品种、小批量生产中，频繁调整程序、更换工装往往意味着更高的成本。
这也让接触判断和柔性物体操作，成为具身智能企业重点突破的方向。
汽车线束装配就是一个典型例子。
线束柔软、容易形变，机器人抓取后，其位置和形态也会随之变化。从取线、布线到插接，机器人需要持续感知物体状态，并根据接触反馈调整动作。同时，插接还要确保连接器到位，避免损伤线缆和端子。
它石智航选择了这一场景。在工博会现场，其机器人演示了由具身大模型驱动的线束自动化装配，通过视觉与力控配合，完成线束定位和精密插接。
另一个热门方向是精密插接。
本届工博会上，智元、艾利特等多家企业都展示了光模块插拔，非夕科技则带来了服务器内存条插装。
其中，艾利特将一套光模块生产工站搬进展馆。5台双臂机器人在同一具身大模型的调度下，反复完成光模块对位、插拔等操作。据企业披露，这套方案的操作精度达到±0.1毫米，并已在光通信等相关产线部署。
看似简单的插接动作，实际对精度和力度要求很高。位置稍有偏差，就可能刮伤光模块的金手指，甚至损坏接口。机器人需要根据接触阻力，及时修正动作。
类似的需求还存在于无序分拣、柔性包装等场景。这些工序的共同特点是物料状态或环境存在不确定性，难以完全依靠预设轨迹完成操作。
当然，传统工业机器人结合视觉、力控等技术，也能处理部分复杂操作。具身智能想创造额外价值，关键在于减少换型编程和工装改造成本，让同一套系统适应更多物料和工况。
不过，目前不少成果仍处于展示或场景验证阶段。要真正进入产线，还需要证明其生产节拍、长期稳定性和综合成本能够满足工业客户的要求。
部署工具成为产品竞争的一部分即使机器人能干活，也未必意味着企业能赚钱。工程交付是另一道门槛。
对于工业客户而言，机器人只是生产系统的一部分。从工艺分析、设备部署，到与PLC、MES等系统对接，再到后续调试和维护，都需要专业人员参与。
如果每拿下一个订单，都需要工程师重新开发、调试，企业就很难摆脱定制化交付的困境。因此，部署工具也成为越来越多企业竞争的焦点。
例如，乐聚推出的工业具身软件平台Taskor，主要解决技能编排、多机调度和系统对接等问题。工程师可以通过图形化工具配置作业流程，再部署到多台机器人，并与工厂MES系统对接。
智元则推出Genie Studio Agent，将视觉感知、运动控制、导航等能力封装为可调用模块，让用户通过拖拽组件完成任务编排。
这些工具都指向同一个目标：降低部署门槛，让机器人进入下一家工厂时，能够少花时间、少用工程师。
与此同时，数据也开始成为竞争的重要资源。
工博会上，节卡展示了JAKA AiHub平台，能够采集、存储和管理机器人在真实场景中的视觉、动作及状态数据，用于后续模型训练和迭代。
相比实验室和专门的数采场，真实工厂拥有更加复杂的物料、工况和操作数据，尤其是异常处理、接触反馈等信息，有助于提升模型对实际生产环境的适应能力。
当然，这些数据也涉及工厂的核心工艺和商业机密，能否获得客户授权并实现合规利用，同样是一道门槛。
对于具身智能企业而言，进入工厂既意味着获得订单的机会，也意味着积累真实数据、反哺模型迭代的可能。
因此，未来工业具身智能的竞争，除了机器人本身的能力，还要看谁能将数据、模型和部署经验沉淀为可复用的工具，真正降低下一次进厂的成本。
结语：谁会改写工业机器人的旧秩序？具身智能正在经历一次角色转换：从试图用通用机器人改造工厂，到主动融入现有工业体系。
但这场融合背后，也隐藏着新的利益博弈。
具身智能企业需要传统厂商的客户、工艺和交付网络，后者同样希望借助AI补齐柔性操作能力。双方既是合作伙伴，也可能成为未来的竞争对手。
问题在于，具身智能企业即便成功进入工厂，也未必能掌握市场的主导权。 如果客户、渠道和系统集成仍掌握在传统厂商手中，新玩家最终可能沦为算法或本体供应商。
因此，未来工业机器人行业的竞争，可能不再以人形机器人和传统工业机器人划分阵营。随着技术边界逐渐模糊，谁能掌握客户需求、主导系统方案，并将技术转化为可规模化交付的产品，谁才更有机会占据产业链的核心位置。
具身智能或许能够打破工业机器人的技术边界，但要改写原有的产业秩序，还需要争夺技术之外的话语权。

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Efficient LLM Tree Search
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22858v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Tree search enhances multi-step reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet prevailing methods expand every step with a fixed budget, irrespective of the marginal utility of expansion. We first show, across existing search algorithms, that continuations sampled from a shared intermediate state are largely duplicates and collapse to a few distinct answers. Critically, we find that the semantic dispersion of sibling actions predicts the redundancy of their downstream continuations, permitting a subtree's budget to be fixed before expansion. An information-theoretic analysis motivates this: treating the per-step budget as the Monte Carlo sample size for estimating a step's residual answer entropy, we derive a sufficient budget that shrinks with sibling dispersion. We accordingly propose $\textbf{Uncertainty-Aware Allocation}$ (UAA), a training-free framework that decouples value from uncertainty: values determine which candidates are promising, while uncertainty, estimated from sibling dispersion at no additional model cost, determines how many merit expansion, via uncertainty-aware pruning and uncertainty-aware budgeting. Across mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and planning benchmarks, UAA reduces token usage by up to $90\%$ and latency by up to $9\times$ at comparable accuracy, generalizing across four tree search algorithms and both open- and closed-source LLMs.

articles.title: 王传福谈对年轻人的建议：年轻时一定要有远大的梦想
articles.text:
快科技10月19日消息，近期，比亚迪2026年第一次临时股东会于坪山总部召开。比亚迪集团董事长王传福在会议现场，分享了他对年轻人的建议。
他表示：“年轻时一定要有远大的梦想，这样才能激励年轻人在遇到困难的时候不放弃，敢于坚持、敢于挑战。比亚迪原来什么都没有，员工人数从几十人到几十万人，期间克服了很多困难，几次差点倒闭。面对困难，我们没有放弃，而是迎接它、拥抱它最终战胜它。”
这份坚持与长期主义，也同样体现在比亚迪核心技术的攻坚路上。此前，在比亚迪智能化战略发布会上，王传福发表演讲。
他介绍，比亚迪拥有7000+人芯片研发团队，1000+亿元芯片投入，4大芯片研发基地，5座晶圆制造厂。
比亚迪实现了芯片产业全链条能力的自主把控，覆盖产品定义、架构设计、电路设计，再到晶圆制造、封装以及测试在内的七大核心环节，也是全球范围内唯一具备芯片全流程自研自制能力的汽车企业。
比亚迪的芯片布局最早可追溯至2002年，当年公司搭建起IC设计团队。
经过24年持续深耕研发，如今已落地超过2000款芯片产品，应用场景横跨汽车、电子、光伏、储能等五大领域，其中车规级芯片数量达到566款。

articles.title: Measuring Mechanistic Uncertainty in Large Language Models via Causal Robustness
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22636v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in critical domains, where their susceptibility to hallucinations makes reliable and interpretable uncertainty quantification essential. We introduce the concept of mechanistic uncertainty, which characterizes uncertainty through the stability of the internal mechanisms supporting a model's response. We propose the causal robustness margin, defined as the minimum internal intervention required to deviate the model's output, and operationalize it using Jacobian Lens (Jlens) concept steering vectors. Across three open-source models and five question-answering datasets, we show incorrect and uncertain responses exhibit smaller margins, indicating greater sensitivity to internal interventions, and the causal robustness margin complements conventional output-based uncertainty methods. Finally, in a controlled knowledge injection experiment, correctly learned facts show increased margins after training, suggesting that causal robustness provides a mechanistically grounded signal of uncertainty.

articles.title: alkhder at ImageEval 2026 Shared Tasks: Constrained Selection and Rotation-Averaged Logit Scoring for Multimodal Hallucination Detection
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.22515v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We describe our submission to Subtask~1b of ImageEval 2026. The task consists of selecting the single visually valid statement from three candidates paired with an image, and is in both English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). Our system uses a pre-trained 7B vision--language model in a zero-shot setting, without task-specific training or fine-tuning. We formulate the task as a constrained selection problem and choose the answer using next-token log-probabilities. To reduce answer-position bias, we apply a Latin-square rotation to the candidate statements. Our system achieves CI scores of 0.0510 on the English test set and 0.0960 on the MSA test set, reducing CI relative to the official 3B baselines reported on devtest by 83.7\% and 80.4\%, respectively.
